tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun zhwa lu lo tsā ba'i rnam par thar pa brjed byang nor bu'i khri shing bzhugs so// na mo gu ra we/ thub pa'i bstan pa lung rtogs rin chen chos/ /bshad dang sgrub pas gces par skyong mkhas shing / /bskal bzang 'gro ba brtse bas legs 'doms pa/ /kun mkhyen lo tsā chen po la btud nas/ /de yi ngo mtshar mdzad pa'i tshogs/ /thos na don can bcas pa'i phyir/ /bsod nams 'dod pas mnyan pa'i rigs/ /de bas brjed byang nyung ngu tsam/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams ni rtag pa'i go 'phang brnyes nas slar yang sems can gyi don la btun pa mi lhod pas 'gro ba'i blo dang 'tshams par sprul pa'i skus 'khor ba na rgyu'o zhes thos so/ /de dag gi mdzad pa gdul bya dang mtshams par bstan pa rnams kyang thos na don che zhing shin tu yid la 'bab pa dang bcas pa'i phyir/ skye bo kun gyi rna lam du bsgrag par bya ba'i rigs kho na yin no/ /de la 'dir rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas kyi rnam par thar pa ches mtha' yas pa las/ 'dir ni re shig nyung ngu rnam par gsal ba'i ngag gis ston par byed do/ /de yang 'di skad ces thos te/ 'o kol gyi rnam par 'dren pa chen po/ chos thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa/ rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po shrī dhar+m+ma pā la bha dra'i zhal snga nas 'di nyid/ sku tshe 'di'i sngon ma ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du paṇ+ḍi ta chen po zhig tu sku skye ba bzung ngo / /zhes grag go /de skad du/ 'phags pa'i yul na mkhas pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gangs can bstan pa'i dpal du legs 'khrungs nas/ /mkhas grub stong rwa ba gsung zhes skyes bu dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ngo / /de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di/ sher phyin dar bar lung bstan pa'i yul byang phyogs kha ba can du/ gtsang gi cha'i sa'i cha zhwa lu gser bkang gi khang gsar gong ma zhes bya bar/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / bu ston rin po che'i slob ma mngon pa rang las mkhas pa rin chen sangs rgyas mgon zhes bya ba sogs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang du byung zhing /

dpon rin chen seng ge sogs mi chos pa'ang che bar byung ba'i gdung rus 'gos kyi rigs su/ yab dpon bsam grub dpal bzang dang / yum dad ldan rin chen chos 'dzom la sras lcam sring bzhi 'khrungs pa las/ rje 'di thog mar 'khrungs pa'i sras pho gcig pu nyid de/ lcags mo bya la sku bltams pa'o/ /lhums su zhugs tshe'ang / yum la mtshan ltas bzang po mang du byung zhing / bltams pa'i tshe na btsas ston kyang cher byas shing / ya mtshan gyi cho 'phrul du ma byung bar snang la/ chos skyong 'bum zhes bya bar mtshan btags so/ /de nas sku legs par bskyed bsrings te gzhon nu'i rol rtsed la rol pa'i tshe'ang / thugs brgyud gnyen zhing ngang ring ba dang / dul bar 'dug pa dang / bag yod pa dang / gnyen gshin pa dang ni ldan/ de yang byis pa tha mal pa ltar mi srun pa ni nam yang mi mnga'/ sku rtsed kyi tshul mdzad pa na'ang / chos 'chad nyan gyi tshul dang / dgon pa lding pa'i tshul dang / dbang bskur ba'i tshul dang / mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul mdzad/ sems can la 'tshe bar gyur pa ni gang yang mi mdzad/ cung zad brnal ba'i tshe na mar me du ba'i snang ba 'char ba sogs/ sngon gyi lung rtogs la sbyangs pa mu med pa rnams kyi 'phros sad pa'i rtags mang du mnga' ste/ gzhon nu de lta bu nas skyes bu dam pa'i mdzad pa lhur mdzad pa zhig go /de nas dgung lo brgyad zhes pa'i tshe/ shar kha ba dang / rin dpungs pa dmag khyer byed pa shar snar thang gi nye log ba lon du g.yul byas tshe/ rje 'di'i yab kyang shar kha ba'i dmag gi gtso bor phebs yod pas/ g.yul ha cang dpa' bas rkyen byas te sku gshegs/ de nas rje'i me me drung chos rgyal bas/ thog mar mi chos la gzhug par dgongs nas/ shar kha chos kyi rgyal po bdag chen bkra shis 'phags pa'i 'dun sar spyan drangs te/ re shig mi chos dang mthun par mdzad cing / rgyal mkhar rtse pa dang / sna'i gnyen du'ang 'gyur bas/

srid zhu phun sum tshogs pas bskur zhing zhugs la/ de'i ring du bod yig dbu can dang / 'bru ma dang / tsheg bris rnams slob dpon kha yar la legs par sbyangs/ bod skad la bag chags chung bas bslab pa dka' mo byung gsung / slar yang zhwa lur gnas brtan legs rgyal ba la'ang bslabs te/ brda dag dang bcas pa dpyis phyin pa mkhyen par mdzad do/ /lan tsha dang bar+dhu sogs kyang khang pa'i bskyed ris la snang ba gzigs pas thugs dgyes te/ bal po lha bzo ba yi ge mkhas par shes pa la bslabs pas mkhas par mkhyen/ rgya bod kyi klog rnams kyang dag par mkhyen pas na bdag chen gyi drung du/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi rtogs brjod dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi rnam thar sogs gsan gang spro thun mdzad de klog pa dang / bdag chen nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang po la chos kyi dri ba mdzad pa'i phrin pa'ang mdzad cing / sku phra yang thugs rdzogs pa dang / dge bshes kun la gus par mdzad pa dang / thugs dam kyang 'bad pa mdzad/ thugs la'ang chos gcig byed dgos dgongs pa byung / mi shi 'dug zer ba dang / dud 'gro gsod pa sogs gzigs pa'i tshe'ang / bcos ma yin pa'i snying rje dang nges 'byung chen po rang dbang med pa 'khrungs shing / 'khor ba la btson dong dang / thar pa la khang bzang lta bu'i thugs ni rgyud mar byung / mi chos kyi tshul bstan kyang / tshangs spyod 'ba' zhig la gnas pa mdzad/ skye bo su la'ang mi brnyas shing / tshig rtsub ngan smra sogs gzhan gyi snying la mi 'bab pa ni nam du'ang mi gsung / gnod lan kyang phan pas sgrub pa kho na mdzad pa lags so/ /de'i tshe chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ brag dkar du sku zhang gi khu bo chos rje rgya mtsho dpal ba la/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ tshe dpag med grub rgyal ma'i dbang / tshe khrid sogs dang / gzhan yang bla ma kha cig la chos gsan no/ /bco brgyad tsam bzhes pa'i tshe/ bdag chen gyis kyang /

zhwa lu khang gsar gong ma ba'i bu 'di la chos kyi bag chags cher gsal ba snang bas/ btsun pa 'os pa 'dug gsungs pa la/ dpon drung pad rgyal bas/ khong tshang rang re'i dpon skya khungs ma yin pa dang / zhwa lu'i shar sgo'ang khong tshang gis 'dzin zhing / khyad par sras pho gcig pu 'di las med pas mi chos rang 'thad zhus pa la/ rje 'di thugs khro ba'i go skabs nam yang med pa zhig yin na'ang / chos kyi gegs su gyur dogs pas/ cung ma dgyes pa byung gsung / de nas thugs la ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab la thos bsam byas chog pa cig nam yongs dgongs pa las re ba gzhan med/ dkon mchog gi rten drung du'ang de ltar grub pa'i smon lam nan tur mdzad cing / bcom ldan 'das yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa de nyid kyi mtshan tsam gsan pa dang / sku 'dra gzigs pa na'ang bcos min gyi dad pas spyan chab 'khrug pa byung / de ltar chos kho na thugs la brnag pa nyid kyis/ mo ston mkhas pa zhig yod pa la mo cha mdzad pas/ khong na re/ sprin cog mo tsam zhig nam mkhar byung / /de je cher song bas nam mkha' khengs/ /zer bas 'di shin tu bzang zer ba'ang byung zhing / bdag chen bkra shis 'phags bzhugs pa'i sku'i ring la/ chos mdzad chog pa'i dgongs bzang yod kyang / ha cang thugs mnyes pas phyag phyi mdzad dgos pa byung ngo / /de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa la chos mdzad par thag bcad/ yum gyis kyang / sngar lhums su zhugs pa dang bltams pa'i dus rnams su bltas bzang po mang du yod pa dang / bag chags gsal ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge bshes chen po gcig 'ong snyam pas/ pha gzhis 'dzin mkhan med kyang chos rang 'thad gsungs te/ bkag pa ma mdzad/ phyis nas kyang rje nyid/ bdag gi yum de rang dad pa dang mos nyams che ba gcig yod/ bdag gi chos la gegs cung zad kyang ma byas gsungs/ sras pho gcig pu yin pas/ yab gzhis 'dzin dgos pa'i nan tur mi mdzad par/

bstan pa la dgongs pa'i lhag bsam de lta bu la dpags te/ mkha' 'gro ma zhig yin par gor ma chag go /der sna tshogs zhes pa chu pho rta lo la/ chos sde chen po dpal 'khor sde chen du/ dbyar zla tha chung gi nywa la mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa lung sde bzhi thugs la bzhugs pa 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas mkhan po dang / chos rje kun dga' dpal bzang pas dge tshul gyi slob dpon mdzad/ mkhan slob de dag gi spyan sngar rab tu byung ba mdzad de/ rin chen chos skyong bzang por mtshan btags/ ngur smrig gi na bza' bsnams te/ tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa mnos shing / thugs la re ba yongs su grub pas dges pa mu med pa byung snang ngo // ༈ /a a/ skyes bu dam pa rnams sku phra mo nas/ de tsam rang gi ngang tshul bzang dang / chos la rtse gcig pa'i 'dun pas 'khor ba la zhen log de lta bu rang / rgya gar gyi dge bshes tsho dang / bod kyi'ang sngon gyi dge bshes tsho la byung thang ang / rnam par thar pa 'di kho nas kyang skyabs su mchi ba der gda'o/ /de ltar rab tu byung nas kyang / ltung ba'i gnas shin tu phra mos kyang ma gos par bslab pa rin po che spyan 'bras ltar bsrungs/ tha na zhal tshom tshun/ skra dang kha spu mnyam du 'breg par gsungs pa yin dgongs nas bzhag pas/ bal po 'dra zer nas/ chos mdzad bal po zhes btags skad do/ /de nas gtsang nyang stod rig pa'i 'byung gnas lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po dpal 'khor sde chen gyi grwa sar/ khang gsar grwa tshang gi slob dpon gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i seng ge dam pa slob dpon rin po che ting nge 'dzin 'od zer ba la btugs te thog mar rig pa la 'jug pa'i sgo bsdus grwa mtha' yas pa nas brtsams te/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba dang / bstan pa'i snying po pha rol tu phyin pa'i bstan bcos 'grel chung don gsal la thugs sbyong mdzad/ thugs rab zab pa dang yangs pa nyid kyis brtson 'grus pa mu med pas brgyan te/

gsan sbyongs kho na rtse gcig tu bsgril bas/ grwa sa'i mig ltos la phan pa byung / long gtam cal col sogs long gtam du 'gro ba cung zad mi mdzad par/ nyin mtshan thog thag tu/ dpe cha 'dzin shar/ rigs lung / mno bsam btong ba sogs 'bad pa ches mtha' yas pa mdzad pas/ gzhan dag gis lo zlar sbyangs pa las/ dam pa 'dis zhag re sbyangs pa yang tshig don la 'dres pa byung ste/ dpang lo chen pos/ sngon tshe sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /gzhung rnams rtsed mo zhar la shes/ /zhes gsungs pa de rang mod pas/ sngon nas sbyangs pa mu med pa'i tshangs la sku tshe 'dir tshegs po mi yong ba yin na'ang / de ltar rje 'di'i thugs bskyed ha cang ches grags pas/ kun gyi blor ma tshud par/ slob dpon dang grwa pa kun na re/ chos mdzad bal po 'di 'dra ci yin mi shes/ gsung rab rnams zhar la tshig don ma lus pa shes 'gro ba cig gda'/ zhes gleng zhing ha las pa byung zhes/ dpal 'khor sde chen du yun ring du bzhugs pa/ chos kyi rje rin po che dkon tshul ba sogs las dngos su thos so/ /de dus rig pa'i stobs rgyas pas/ phyir rgol ba'i spobs pa 'phrog nus pa byung ste/ grub mtha' ma dag pa 'ga' la dgag gzhag kyang mdzad do/ /de nas slob dpon ting nge 'dzin pa/ nyi ma zhes pa chu mo lug gi ston dus sku gshegs pas/ gsol btab dgongs rdzogs sogs la brtson pa mdzad cing / de nas mkhas pa'i dbang po chen po chos kyi rje bsod grags pa yongs 'dzin du bsten te/ 'grel pa don gsal rong ṭīka gi steng nas zhib tu bshad pa/ mdo sde rgyan phywa pa'i ṭī ka dang bcas pa rgyud bla 'byed gnyis dang bcas pa bzad pa blo rgyam pa'i ṭī ka'i steng nas zhib tu bshad pa/ kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang bka' chos rje don grags pa las brgyud pa/ phag dkar/ par+ṇa sha wa ri/ rnam 'joms rnams kyi rjes gnang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel shong 'gyur la/

bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i mchan gyis gsal bar byas pa/ kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang bka' chos rje do/ sa bcad/ chos 'byung / mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭī ka rnams kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa/ mkhan chen dharma shrī ba'i zin bris rnams gsan/ de dag kyang tshig tsam ma yin par ṭīka gzhung byin thugs la gsal bar bzung ste/ tshig don thams cad dpyis phyin par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang mtshan brjod jo nang 'gyur gsar/ kun mkhyen chen po jo mo nang pa'i nges don rgya mtsho sa bcad dang bcas pa/ bka' bsdu bzhi pa/ sham+bha la'i bstod pa che chung sogs mang du gsan te/ rgyas par gsan yig las shes shing / de ltar mdo sngags kyi chos mang po thugs su chud nas/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa/ sa skyong zhes pa chu mo bya'i dpyid dus/ zhwa lu ri phug tu thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston gyi dus mchod chen mo la phyogs ris nas kyang grwa bskor ba sogs dge bshes rag pa 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ byams chos lnga la gtso bor bshad pa mdzad de/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad phul du phyin pas/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dpyis phyin pa 'grel pa'i tshig don phun sum tshogs pa byung bas/ dge bshes chen po mang du bzhugs pa rnams ha las pa lta bu'i thugs dgyes pa byung ste/ 'di lta bu'i bshad pa ya mtshan pa rang sngon byung ba ma dran zhes gsung zhing / kun gyi bstod bkur bsngags pa chen po phul/ de lta bu'i ngo mtshar la lha rnams kyang yid rangs pas/ grwa bskor mdzad pa'i nyi ma dang po nas me tog gi char chen po babs pa skye bo kun gyis mthong ba sogs ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul bgrangs las 'das pa byung zhes/ zhwa lu pa'i grwa bgres 'ga' las dngos su thos pa'i rje nyid kyi drung du de ltar bden lags sam zhus pas/ me tog babs par snang yang 'u cag la babs pa rang min gsungs te/ de 'dra mkhas pa chen po'i gsungs khengs skyung pa rang lags mod/

de ltar grwa bskor mdzad pa'i mod de nas/ sngon 'phags pa'i yul du 'khrungs pa'i bag chags bsal ba'i dbang gis dang / thugs dgongs la'ang 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa thob pa la/ rgyu rig pa'i gnas lnga shes dgos par rgyal ba ma pham pas kyang gsungs shing / bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab 'di rnams legs par sbyar ba'i skad du gsungs la/ bsdud pa po rnams kyis kyang de ltar bsdus shing / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos mdzad pa rnams legs par sbyar ba'i skad las ma 'das par nges la/ de yang spyir gsung rab thams cad tshig don gnyis su gnas pa las/ thog mar tshig shes dgos/ de la'ang don shes par bya dgos na/ tshig de ni ting sub ti mtha' can du nges pa nyid dang / de dag gi rnam 'gyur/ ngo bo las ched du bya ba sogs dang / gzhan dang / dus gsum sogs sgra rig pa las shes dgos pa'i phyir dang / lo tsā ba kha cig gis 'gyur ba dang / la la yi ge pas bris nor du yod pa rnams kyang / rgya dpe la gtugs te dag par ma byas na gzhan gyis shes mi nus pa dang / gsang sngags la'ang sngags ma dag par bzlas pas don phyin ci log tu 'gyur ba sogs 'khrul pa 'khrul gzhis dang bcas pa thams cad sgra shes na shes nus pas/ de yang / rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen pos/ mkhas pa zer ba mang na yang / /sde snod lhums su zhugs ma zhugs/ /sgra tshad 'phrang la shar na gsal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ sgra rig 'di shin tu gces par dgongs nas/ thog mar rtogs sla ba rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba slob dpon dbang phyug go chas mdzad par grags pa ka lā pa gsan par bzhed pa la/ de dus zhwa lu na skad gnyis smra ba gnas brtan legs rgyal ba bzhugs pas khong pa sgra la mkhas par bdog pas/ khong gi sar phebs te/ kho bo sgra shes pa zhig byed 'dod pa/ thos so ba tsam min pa'i dpyis phyin pa gcig bslab par zhus pas/ drung nas gzhan dang mi 'dra/

rjes su yi rang mkhas pa zer ba de mdzad na sgra shes dgos pa bdog la/ da ni drung nas rang dang por ka lā pa'i gzhung / byings mdo/ uṇa sogs rnams khyis bdas kyang thon pa/ zhal ba'i khar sran ma bkrams pa lta bu gang 'dod nas blangs chog pa cig mdzad pa zhu/ de nas 'am bus/ a ru ra lag mthil du bzhag pa ltar/ sgra rig pa phyag tu gsal sing 'bul ba lags gsung bas/ de kha bzhin/ mdo gsum po thugs la byang bar bzung ste/ snar thang lo tsā ba'i rnam bshad las gsan te/ sa ris skyar cag sogs la brtson pa chen po mdzad pas zla ba gnyis na shin tu byang ba dang bcas te rdzogs pa mkhyen/ de'i zhar la sdeb sbyor kyang shān+ti pa nyid kyi gzhung rtsa 'grel las rdzogs par mkhyen te/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i brgyud pa la/ legs sbyar gyi skad du/ dbang po rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa'i snyan ngag bstod pa'ang mdzad cing / slob dpon daṇ+ḍa'i snyan ngag me long kyang / dpang lo chen po'i 'grel pa'i steng nas zhib bshad du gsan te/ snyan ngag rtsom pa la skal ba chen po mnyes par gyur to/ /de ltar na/ zla ba gnyis kyi ring la ka lā pa dang / sdeb sbyor dang / tshig rgyan gyi bstan bcos rnams mthar thug pa mkhyen/ de la ka lā pa ni/ uṇa sogs/ nyer bsgyur dang bcas pa'i zur bkol rnams kyang mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa thugs la longs te/ mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa mkhyen pas/ slob dpon rin po che skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po legs rgyal ba nyid thugs dges te/ drung nas sngon sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa zhig yin par gda' yang slob pa'i tshul bstan de mchi gsungs nas bya dga' dang yi rangs chen po mdzad do/ /gzhan dag gis 'tshams sbyor lnga pa'ang zla chos yin na/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni zla ba gnyis na/ kā la pa cha lag dang bcas pa snyan ngag sdeb sbyor rnams ril gyis rdzogs par mkhyen pa lags so/ /de lta bu'i mkhyen pa'i snyan grags kyang /

phyogs su khong du khyab pa las/ lo de'i dbyar smad bsam gling du bzhugs tshe phyogs phyogs nas/ sgra don gnyer gyi grwa pa yang 'dus pa las/ bshad nyan kyang mthar phyin pa mdzad do/ /de yang sngon gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir ka lā pa 'chad pa rnams/ grub pa yi ge zhes pa nas/ byings sgrub dang bcas pa 'chad pas/ tshegs shin tu che zhing / gzhung gi 'bru gnyer ba'ang zhib tu dka' ba yod skad/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta shrī ma ṇi ka la rje btsun 'jam dpal gyis zhal dngos su bstan nas man ngag gi bshad pa rtogs sla ba gzhung gi don rnams blo yul du 'char bde ba 'di bstan/ paṇ+ḍi ta des/ bo dong lo tsā ba rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gsungs/ khong gi snar thang lo tsā ba saṃ gha shrī la gsungs/ des gnas brtan legs rgyal ba la/ de la rje 'dis gsan pas na/ sngon med pa'i man ngag gi bshad pa/ tshegs chung ngus shes par 'gyur ba ni/ ding sang / rje 'di nyid kyi gsung las mched pa las/ gzhan med par gda' 'o/ /de ltar na/ phul du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi srol stod pa'i shing rta chen po yang / rjes 'di nyid kho na'o/ /de nas sngar rab tu byung ba'i mkhan po chos kyi rje 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas rtse chen chos sde na sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i khrid gsungs pa gsan te/ thugs dgongs la/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma la sogs pa nas/ so sor bsdud dang bsam gtan dang / /zhes sogs gsungs pa'i sbyor ba yan lag drug pa/ theg pa thams cad kyi bla na med pa'i tshul/ bstan pa rab 'byams rgya mtsho lta bu'i snying po/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam mchog rnal 'byor pa bskal pa bzang po can rnams kyis skye ba 'di la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i nye lam/ yid ches pa gsum ldan gyi phyag rgya chen po zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor/

rgyud sde thams cad kyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid phyag rgya chen po 'di nyid cis kyang nyan dgos/ de yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam 'phrul/ rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa kun mkhyen chen po dpal jo mo nang pa'i zhal snga nas thugs nyams su bzhed don phyin ci ma log par ston pa'i bshad srol/ byin rlabs kyi drod ma yal/ brgyud pa zam ma chad pa'i bka' babs chen po mnga' ba/ rje btsun chen po 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i zhal snga nas te/ sprul pa'i sku 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa'i mkhas pa chen po rtogs pa mchog brnyes pa yin pas/ ci nas kyang mnyan te nyams su blangs dgongs nas/ bsam gling nas rtse chen du thegs/ nyams khrid du rgyas par ni gsan/ sngon 'gro nas brtsams te bsgrub pa la rtse gcig tu zhugs/ byed bcings kyang dam pa mdzad/ khrid yig thog mtha' bar dge ngo sprod gsang don rab gsal dus kyi 'khor lo'i mchog dbang gong ma/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang don gsal byed dang bcas la sogs pa nas gsan te/ sku nyams su ltar ba de ltar/ thugs la rtog pa'ang ji ltar bshad pa bzhin 'khrungs pa las gzhan lta ga la zhig go /gzhan yang / bka' lung snga phyir 'di dag gsan te/ dge slong pha'i so sor thar pa'i rgyud lnga/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rnams kyi bshad pa/ dus 'khor chos 'byung chos rje phyogs las pas mdzad pa rgyud 'bum pu ti bzhi gsan pa'i dum bu dang po nas mtshan yang dag par brjod pa phan yon dang bcas pa/ rtsa rgyud kyi dum bu dbang mdor bstan/ dus 'khor bsdus rgyud le'u lnga pa/ rgyud phyi ma kun spangs chos grags dpal bzang gis bsgyur ba/ rigs drug mnyam par ston pa sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor rgyud phyi ma dang bcas pa/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud/ mngon brjod bla ma/ dum bu gnyis pa na/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ bde mchog sdom byung /

mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ he ru ka mngon byung / rnal 'byor ma kun spyod/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi kha sbyor gyi rgyud/ phag mo mngon byung / phag mo sgrub thabs/ dum bu gsum pa na/ dpal sam+bu ṭa/ gsang ba rdo rje/ gsang ba kun spyod/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa/ nam mkha' sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud/ rin chen phreng ba/ dam tshig chen po/ stobs po che/ ye shes gsang ba/ ye shes phreng ba/ ye shes 'bar ba/ zla ba'i phreng ba/ rin chen 'bar ba/ nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ ye shes rgyal po/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro gsang ba/ gsang ba me 'bar/ gsang ba bdud rtsi/ dur khrod rgyan/ rdo rje rgyal po/ ye shes gsang ba/ chags pa'i rgyal po/ mkha' 'gro ma'i sdom pa/ mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba 'bar ba/ rdo rje 'jigs byed/ rnam par 'joms pa/ rdo rje grub pa drwa ba sdom pa/ stobs chen ye shes rgyal po/ dur rgyan rmad du byung ba/ bde mchog nam mkha' dwangs pa'i rgyud/ mgon po dngos grub 'byung ba/ brtag pa gnyis/ rdo rje gur/ phyag chen thig le/ ye shes snying po/ rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud ye shes thig le/ de kho na nyid sgron ma/ sangs rgyas thod pa/ sgyu ma chen mo/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud/ badz+ra a ra li/ ri ṣi a ra li/ dum bu bzhi pa na/ rdo rje'i gdan bzhi'am rgyud gnyis/ gdan bzhi'i bshad rgyud sngags kyi cha/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po/ gtum po khro bo chen po'i rgyud rnams kyi lung sogs rgya cher gsan te/ rgyas pa ni gsan yig las shes par bya'o/ /gsung chos de dag gsan ring / rtse chen nas/ zhwa lu sku zhang gi sras mo bdag mo bde bzang pas gsol chas zhabs thog thon par mdzad/ de nas skyis mkhar dgon pa rdzong du phebs te/ mkhyen rab dbang phyug grags pa bzang po'i bu chen chos kyi rje chos rin dpal ba la/ chos mngon pa kun las btus dang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa ṭī ka dang bcas pa snga chos dgongs chos mdzad/

phal che ba gsan grub/ de nas re shig dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs te/ chos rje rin po che bsod grags pa yongs 'dzin du bstan bzhin pa las/ gsung rab la gzigs rtogs sogs gsan bsam gyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad pa mdzad cing / de dus/ ngor e waṃ chos ldan du thogs shig phebs/ mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa chos rje kun dga' dbang phyug pa la/ lam 'bras gsan par bzhed de/ de yang rgyud sde mtha' dag gi nying khu/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bi ru pa'i khyad chos/ grub chen ga ya dha ra'i gser chos/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ 'bras bu lam dang bcas pa/ skyon yon tan du blang ba/ bar chad dngos grub tu blang ba sogs zab gnad ston pa rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i dbang bzhi'i nyams len thun mong ma yin pa/ dbang po rno brtul bar ma gsum la thabs khyad par du 'phags pa/ tshe 'di nyid dam/ skye ba bdun nam/ tha na skye ba bcu drug na bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa rdo rje 'dzin pa ma ning gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa'i thabs ston pa'i gsung ngag rin po che gsan pa la thugs mdun drag par byung bas/ rje nyid la gsol ba 'debs pa mdzad pas thugs dges pa dang bcas pas kye rdor rgyu dbang / lam dbang / bdag med ma'i dbang / lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid rdzogs par gsan zhing / gzhan yang snga phyir gsan pa ni rnam 'joms bir lugs kyi dbang / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang / gur lha bcu gnyis ma'i rjes gnang / 'grel pa dag ldan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing / rgyud sde spyi rnam/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong / kye rdor mngon dkyil mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa/ gtor chog las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rab gnas bzang drug rnams kyi bshad pa la sogs pa gsan no/ /ngor du bzhugs ring de la'ang / sgra don gnyer ba kha cig 'dus pa la/ ka lā pa'i 'chad nyan kyang legs par mdzad do/

/de nas slar dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs tshe/ mkhar kha na/ chos rje skad gnyis smra ba mkhas pa chen po shes rab rin chen pa'i zhal snga nas dang mjal te/ chos 'khor sgang du zhabs 'bring kyang mdzad/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bdun gong ma dang bcas pa rgyud 'grel gyi bshad lung / nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud 'grel gyi sa bcad/ 'grel chen gyi spyi don/ bde mchog bstod 'grel/ rdo rje snying 'grel la sogs pa gsan no/ /de nas dpal 'khor bde chen du dgung lo nyer drug pa mi bzad pa zhes bya ba me mo khyi'i lo'i yongs su grags pa'i ston zla rwa ba gro zhun gyi zla ba'am mkhas pa dag khrums kyi zla bar bzhed pa'i phyed 'dzin gyi phyogs dang po'i gral tshes lnga pa hor gyi zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyi shu la nyin 'dzin gyi cha bcu gnyis yod pa'i nyin mo'i cha/ phyi dro'i dus grib ma skyes bu gcig pa dang / rkang pa gcig yod pa'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ yul kha ba can gyi ljongs/ gtsang gi sa nyang stod kyi sa'i thig le dpal 'khor lo sde chen zhes pa'i gtsug lag khang du/ mkhan po rgyud sde rab 'byams kyi mnga' bdag chos kyi rje don grub grags pa dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / las kyi slob dpon gnas brtan chen po sde snod bzhi pa bka' bcu 'dzin pa bsod nams grags pa'i zhabs dang / gsang ste ston pa slob dpon lung rig smra ba'i dbang po bla ma mkhar chen brag pa bsod nams blo gros dang / dad pa'i dge 'dun kun dga' blo gros pa sogs kyis las kyi kha bskangs te/ mtha' 'khob tu bcu'i tshogs grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa mnos te/ bslab khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum mtha' dag la nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos pa'i sdom brtson chen por bzhugs pa yin no/ /gzhan yang sa'i yongs sbyong nas bshad pa ltar/ mang du gsan pas ngom pa med pa'i rje btsun dam pa'i zhal snga nas 'di nyid/

slar yang chos 'khor sgang du thegs te/ 'u yug gling dkar/ rdzong dkar sogs su chos bar la thegs pa'i ring phyag phyi mdzad de/ bi kra ma shī la'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po a bha ya ka ras phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rdo rje phreng ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang bka'/ kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs las brgyud pa dang / dkyil mchog rdo rje phreng ba/ mngon rtogs rnal 'byor rdzogs phreng / sbyin sreg 'od kyi snye ma ste phreng ba skor gsum du grags pa'i lung / gsang ba 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi dbang / sgrol ma bla med lha bcu bdun gyi dbang / phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lung / bya ba'i rgyud chen bzhir grags pa dang / so so'i rgyud gnyis yod pa'i so so'i rgyud la/ de pa'i rigs/ pad+ma'i rigs/ rdo rje'i rigs/ nor can gyi rigs/ lnga rtsen gyi rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs dang drug yod pa'i/ de pa'i rigs la/ rigs kyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po/ rigs kyi gtsug tor/ rigs kyi khro bo khro mo/ rigs kyi pho nya mo/ de pa'i rigs su bsdu ba'i byang sems/ gnas gtsang gi lha la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams su yod pa'i rigs kyi yum stong chen rab 'joms/ rma bya chen mo/ so so 'brang ma/ bsil ba tshal/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin te/ gzungs grwa lngar grags pa'i dbang / bya rgyud kyi gtsug tor gyi rigs/ gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rjes gnang / 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / so so thar pa'i mdo'i bshad pa/ sher phyin gyi mdo'i sdus don dngos brgyad don bdun cur bsdus nas ston pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa don gsal dang bcas pa'i bshad bka'/ 'phags pa thogs med kyi dga' ldan du rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten las byon te/ byams pa'i gsung la zin bris mdzad par grags pa'i sa sde lnga dang / sdom gnyis kyi nang nas theg pa thun mong ba'i sdom theg pa rnam nges dang / thob pa rnam nges dang /

chos rnam nges dang / 'bel gtam rnam nges bzhi ston pa/ mngon pa kun las btus kyi bshad pa zhib mo/ gzhan yang / 'jam bsdud bzang gsum/ bya rgyud bdag po'i rigs dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud/ 'dul ba sum brgya pa 'grel pa 'od ldan dang bcas te zhib bshad/ sgrol ma'i bstod pa rnam dag gtsug nor/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bstan pa spyi bstod/ nyid kyi bstod pa/ bsod nams skyes la gdams pa/ lam rim smon lam 'dul ba'i bslab bya rnams kyi bshad pa/ sher phyin rdo rje gcod pa/ dpang lo chen pos sgrigs pa'i gzungs 'bum/ 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed kyi kha dog bsgyur ba'i ltung byed las ma rnams kyi pham pa dang po yin/ phran tshegs bam po lnga bcu rtsa dgu pa la mjug nas bam po bdun ma gtogs tshang ba'i lung / mngon pa mdzod kyi mtshan las ming ni 'pho ba'i phyir/ zhes pa nas gang zag bstan pa yan/ spyod 'jug gi bzod le brtson 'grus le'u rnams kyi bshad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i ṭī ka'i steng nas gsan/ yang rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i grub mtha' kun shes rtsa 'grel gyi bshad pa/ bka' gdams glegs bam/ thig chen bcu drug gi dbang bka'/ pha chos bu chos cha lag dang bcas pa la bka' gdams glegs bam du grags pa'i lung rnams gsan pa yin no/ /ka lā pa'i tshig don byang bar mkhyen yang / legs bshad kyi cha 'dra 'ong ngam 'ong rje nyid la ngam dgongs nas nyid kyi ṭī ka las kun bshad yan tsam gsan te sngar las lhag pa'i cha mi snang zhing / byings sgrub kha cig gi rjes 'grel dbyi ba'i mdo ma rnyed snang ba sogs la/ legs bshad phar phul chog pa byung bas/ rje nyid thugs shin tu dges pa byung zhing / me long kyang spang ṭīka las gsan te/ de ltar na/ zla ba bcu phyin zhabs pad bsten pa mdzad do/ /dpon slob thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu gyur pa byung lags so/ /de nas dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs/

slar yang ngor la bskor gcig phebs te/ gsung chos kyang gsan la chos kyi rnam grangs ni sngar sdom te smos pa ltar ro/ /ngor du bzhugs pa'i ring la/ 'grel chen sgron gsal/ kri ya sa muts+tsha sogs rgya dpe mang du gzigs te/ bod dpe dang sbyar ba'i zhu chen rgya chen po mdzad do/ /ngor nas/ rje nyid dpon slob gsum rang mdzad de khro phu'i gnas mjal la phebs shing / sngon nas slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i tsan+d+ra bya ka ra ṇa gsan par bzhed pa la/ sngar chos rje shes rin pa la slob pa zhus na'ang ṭī ka mi 'dug pas mi yong / lo chen thugs rje dpal ba'i zhabs 'bring yun ring du mdzad pa dpal sdings lo tsā ba grags pa blo gros pa mkhas par bdog pas/ khong la bslab pa zhu gsung ba'i lung bstan kyang yod pa bzhin/ khro phu nas tshur lam dpal sdings su phebs te/ lo tsā ba la ja 'dren dang 'bul nod kyang mdzad/ tsan+d+ra pa dpyis phyin pa bslab par zhu ba mdzad pas/ khong gis yid rangs dang dges pa chen po dang bcas te zhal gyis bzhes/ de ltar snyan bcag mdzad nas/ slar dpal 'khor lo bde chen du phyag phebs/ sku chas nyer spyad rnams sgrubs te dpal sdings su phyag thegs te thogs mar tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo/ byings kyi tshogs/ u ṇa sogs dang bcas pa/ rgya gar gyi skad du thugs 'dzin mdzad de 'grel pa dharma dā pa dang / lo chen thugs rje dpal ba'i rnam bshad chen mo las gsan zhing / rnam bshad dang 'grel pa dharma dā pa dge bshes gsal bar mi ston pa kha cig dka' gnas su yod pa rnams ni 'grel bshad rat+na ma ti las/ rgya dpe'i steng nas mtha' dpyad dang bcas pa gsan pas/ rnam bshad la mi 'thad pa du re snang ba rnams kyang dag par mdzad nus pa byung zhing / gzhan yang tsan+d+ra pa'i cha lag yi ge'i mdo/ ting mtha' dang / supa mtha' dang / u ṇa sogs kyi 'grel pa dang / nyer bsgyur gyi 'grel pa la sogs pa rnams kyang gsan zhing / mngon brjod 'chi med mdzod/

thu mi'i sum rtags/ sngags klog mun gsal sgron me/ dpang lo chen po'i tshogs gsung gsal ba rnams gsan te/ zla ba bzhi la ril rdzogs su byang par mkhyen pa'o/ /tsan+d+ra byā ga ra ṇa dang / ka lā pa sogs sgra mdo mtha' yas pa bzhugs kyang / tshig nyung ngus don gsal zhing rdzogs pa ni tsan+d+ra pa kho na yin no/ /de'i phyir/ paṇ+ḍi ta chos 'phags kyi 'grel pa bdud rtsi dā pa dang / paṇ+ḍi ta rin chen blo gros kyi 'grel bshad rat+na ma ti dang / paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa tsan+d+ras 'grel bshad kyi bshad pa stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa zhig mdzad de/ 'phags pa'i yul na shin tu dar zhing rtsis che bar mdzad pa'i bstan chos sh+lo ka bdun brgya pa/ pā ṇi ni'i rjes su 'brangs te mdzad do/ /de yang slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi ni dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma sogs nas lung bstan pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba yin/ de'i legs bshad kyi srol/ bod du ni shongs ston mkhas pa'i dbang po rdo rgyan gyis btsugs pa nas bzung / thugs rje dpal ba dpon slob yan la dar bar yod na'ang / phyis bdag nyid chen po 'di ma gtogs pa/ ding sang tsan+d+ra pa 'chad nus pa gcig kyang med/ da ni rje'i gsungs la mched pa mang bar bzhugs so/ /de'i phyir phul du byung ba'i legs bshad kyi srol mi nub pa'i nyin mor byed pa gcig pu kho na yin no/ /de ltar dpal sdengs su tsan+d+ra pa gsan ring / bdag chen bkra shis rab brtan pas/ bdag po phag rgod khyung rgyal la phyag dam mdzad de/ seng ge rtse nas zhabs tog mtha' yas pa mdzad do/ /de nas ni bod du 'gyur ba'i sgra mdo chen mo gnyis cha lag dang bcas pa/ tshig brgyan mngon brjod sdeb sbyor la sogs pa rang dbang du gyur pas lo tsā ba chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad cing / phyogs su'ang lo tsā ba chen po'i snyan pa chen po byung bas/ bstan pa gces spras su byed pa'i lha mi rnams kyi yid gsos dam par gyur pa lags so/

/de nas lce khyi 'brug dang / lce bsgom rdzong pa sogs mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i zhing / dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sku zhang chen po'i gdung brgyud/ mdo sngags bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes pas/ don gyis na rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ lha sar phebs na mkha' 'gro mas jo bo shāka rnam gnyis la zhal gser rgyu'i gser btul ma phul ba/ zhwa lu'i dpal ldan mas rjes bzhin du 'brangs te phrin las bsgrub pa'i skyes chen dam pa/ sku zhang chos rje rin po che mkhyen rab mchog grub dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas de nyid ni/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la bka' drin zla ma mchis shing / thugs dad rang dbang med par tshud pa'i sku tshe snga ma nas kyi bla ma yin/ dus phyis nas kyang sku zhang chos rje'i rnam thar dang 'phros gleng cung zad re byung na'ang / spyan chab dbang med du 'khrungs pa zhig yod/ de yang dang po/ sku zhang chos rje nyid kyis mtshan gsan pa na'ang thugs dad bcos min du 'khrungs pas/ skom pa chu 'dod pa ltar mjal ba'i thugs 'dun drag po byung bas/ sngar zhwa lur gnas brtan lo tsā ba la sgra gsan pa'i dus mjal ba sogs nas bzung / dpon slob thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs rtse gcig pa pha dang bu'i rnam thar las gzhan du lta ga la zhig pa byung bar gda'/ de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa la gsung chos kyi bka' drin snga phyir nod pa'ang 'di dag ste/ bya rgyud pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo/ tshe dpag 'chi med lnga sgra'i dbang / spyod rgyud rnam snang mngon byang sku mi bzad pa rgyan gyi bkod pa'i 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang / spyod rgyud phyag rdor 'gro bzang gi dbang / 'gro bzang lugs kyi phyag rdor/ rnam sras zhi drag gi rjes gnang / rnal 'byor rgyud rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang / rdo rje 'byung ba'i rnam bshad rin po che bsam 'phel gyi bshad pa/

mi 'khrugs pa jo lugs kyi dbang dang / dkyil chog gi lung / dus 'khor dkyil chog bus mdzad pa/ rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i phyag len zin bris kyi lung / sgyu 'phrul chen po lha lnga'i dbang / mngon rtogs gnyis dang dkyil chog gi lung / bla med pha rgyud gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang / 'grel pa don gsal gyi lung / gshed dmar gyi dbang bzhi/ shin tu spros med kyi khrid/ rang byin rlabs/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi byin rlabs/ gshed dmar lha lnga'i mngon dkyil/ sbyin sreg mchod phreng / drug cu pa'i gtor chog gshed dmar spros med kyi rtsa ba mthu stobs dbang phyug gis mdzad pa/ glo bo lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i 'khrid/ yig nag 'bum du grags pa/ rten 'brel rdzas kyi rnal 'byor zhal shes/ 'phags pa'i dris lan/ gong mo mkhar pa shes rab dar gyis mdzad pa'i rnam rtog 'od gsal/ phyir ldog bskor gsum/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi rtsa ba bi ru pas mdzad pa/ 'grel pa 'jug bde rnam gsal/ bdud rtsi byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba/ rnal 'byor bzhi rim/ spros med dpyal lugs/ nirka laṅga'i gsung la dpyal los zin bris mdzad pa/ chos rje thugs sras pa spros med gsung dus chos grub dar gyi zin bris mdzad pa rnams kyi lung / dus 'khor rgyud phyi ma/ nges don rnye ma/ dbang mdor bstan gyi ṭī ka mkhas pa dga' byed/ sbyin sreg gnyis/ 'khrul 'khor gyi dpe/ sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi thog mtha' bar dge'i khrid/ ngo sprod gcer mthong ngo shes rnams nyams khrid du gsan zhing / gzhan yang / dbyangs can ma'i rjes gnang / tho yig gi lung / mai tri mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang la sogs pa rnams gsan te/ rgyas par gsan yig las shes so/ /de nas rgyal mkhar rtse pa'i bdag chen 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul/ chos rgyal mi'i dbang po bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa skye dgu mtha' dag gi nyer 'tsho chen por gyur pa/

ta'i si dhu dpal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa'i zhal snga nas de nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rmad byung rnam dkar rgya chen po'i srol gtod pa/ phyag bzhes su rgyun ma chag par 'debs pa mtha' yas pa phun tshogs bco brgyad du grags pa rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa lo re bzhin yang / bka' 'gyur gser chos pu ti bcu gsum re dang / bstan 'gyur skya chos pu ti bcu gsum re bzhengs kyi yod pa la/ zhu dag pa la'ang / sde snod gsum 'dzin pa/ theg pa gsum la nges par sbyangs pa/ rig pa'i gnas bcu khong du chud pa re spyan 'dren pa yin skad/ de la bdag chen bkra shis rab brtan pas bdag nyid chen po 'di la mchid gsol te/ nged kyi khu bo bdag chen chos kyi rgyal pos srol gtad pa'i dge ba'i mdzad pa brlab po che'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ gsung rab yi ger 'god pa'ang 'di'i srol je bzang du 'gyur na'ang / zhus dag pa mchog tu gyur pa dkon na/ nyid lta bu chos du ma la mkhyen pa'i spyan bkra bar shes pas bstan pa la gces spras su 'gyur ba'i zhu chen mdzod cig pa'i lung nod pas/ rje nyid kyi thugs la'ang / spyir bka' bstan bcos la blta thog bgyid pa la dpe cha'ang 'dzom pa yong bar snang zhing / gsung rab bzhengs pa mang na yang / dag po ches dkon par gda' bas/ zhu chen dag po bgyis na bstan pa la'ang phan che dgongs nas zhal gyis mches te phyag len la btab/ de'ang phyi mo la legs par gtugs te/ don zhus dang tshig zhus kyi cha dpyis phyin par mdzad/ bod kyi sgra mdo sum cu pa dang / rtags 'jug dang bstun te zhu dag la 'kho ba'i dag yig kyang thugs rtsom mdzad/ rgya dpe rnyed pa kha cig ni rgya dpe la gtugs te/ 'gyur chad rnams bsab pa dang / mi bcos su mi rung ba dag bcos shing gtan la phab pas/ deng sang gi bar rje nyid kyis zhus dag mdzad pa'i glegs bam rnams kho na la dpang po zhus te bgyid par snang ngo /

/de lta bu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa la byi dor phyag bris rgya chen po 'gran zla dang bral ba kho na lags so/ /de ltar ni dgung lo nyer lnga nas/ bzhi bcu'i bar tsam du mdzad de/ lo bco lnga'i ring tsam mo/ /zhus dag mdzad pa de yang / dpyid dbyar gyi ring mdzad/ ston dgun gung sang gi tshul du zhwa lu sogs su phebs pa dang / gsung chos gnang ba dang / 'chad pa dang / phyag dpe 'dri ba dang / chos sgyur ba dang / brtsom pa dang / thugs dam zab mo'i ngang du sku 'tshams sogs mdzad/ ri khrod dga' ldan pa sogs la dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi bshad pa'ang gsung / de la dus re zhig gi tshe/ zhwa lur sgra don gnyer ba 'ga' zhig la gsung chos gnang / de dus sku zhang chos rje rin po ches gnang ba'i ther ma sku 'dabs kyi rgyu bzang ba gcig yod pa la tshos mdzad de/ nyin gcig bla yer skem du bzhag khang thog nas dpon slob tshos sa ris mdzad pa dang bstun te/ thugs rtog mdzud pa'i lugs mdzad na'ang / sa ris la thugs yangs/ re shig gzigs pa ma byung / de nas gzigs tshe/ ther ma mis khyer nas mi gda' skad/ phyis sku zhang gi gcung po chos rje mthu stobs pas khungs chod nas/ rje nyid kyi kha sang gi ther ma rku mi kho/ nged kyis shes byung bas/ kho la chad las dang / ther ma longs pa nged kyis bgyid gsungs na'ang / rje btsun dam pa 'di nyid rnam pa thams cad du bdag pas gzhan gces kyi mdzad pa kho na sku nyams su bzhes pa zhig lags pas/ sku zhang la/ ther ma bdag gis blos btang tshar bas mi dgos lags na chad las smos ci 'tshal bar zhus pas skyes bu dam pa gsung nas yi rang mang po yang mdzad/ de ltar thos pa rnams kyang dad pa dbang med du tshud pa byung zhes zhwa lu pa sogs da lta'i bar yang yang gleng gi gda'o/ /de ltar zhus dag gi ring chos gsan pa dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa sogs ni gong du yang smos pa ltar yin la/ gzhan yang gsung chos 'di dag gsan te/

dpal 'khor lo sde chen du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum la shin tu mkhas pa'i dus zhabs pa chen po thar pa bzang po'i spyan sngar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gong ma bzhi/ gong ma chen po rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang dang bcas pa gsan/ mi 'khrugs pa jo bo lugs 'jam dbyangs rin rgyal ba'i yig cha'i steng nas gsan pa sogs so/ /de nas dgung lo so bdun pa tsam gyis dus/ rje nyid kyi yum rang bzhin gyi mkha' 'gro ma de nyid sku gshegs te/ dpal 'khor sde chen du spyan 'dren pa byung bas/ rje nyid yum la shin tu gus pas thugs la nges 'byung dang skyo shas cher byung na'ang / spyir 'dus byas thams cad kyi ngang tshul 'di las ma 'das/ khyad par bdag gi ma de dang por lus bskyed/ bar du brtse bas bskyangs/ da ni chos la bskul ba'i thabs byas so dgongs nas/ chos thog tu bzhag na'ang / thugs la dran pa rang byung gsung / de nas bzung ste thugs sna'ang thung phun song gsung / de nas dgongs rdzogs dmigs su 'gro ba mdzad/ gdung zhugs la sbyangs te/ sats+tshā btab/ zhwa lur/ shar chen dkar so grwa tshang yin pa dang / grang chen pa la/ nag nya sgrub mchod kyi thos su/ zhing bzang po kha cig kyang phul te/ des sang gi bar brtan chags pa yin/ de ltar drin can gyi yum rin po che'i bka' drin subs shing / de nas skabs shig tu rgya gar rdo rje gdan nas dpag tshad brgyas bgrod pa'i gnas/ gtsang la stod grom pa rgyang gi sa'i cha/ 'jam dbyangs bdun brgyud du 'khrungs pas bstan pa'i 'byung gnas lta bu/ bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang mjal ba thegs te/ gnas rnams zhib mor mjal bas/ thugs dad dang mi rtag pa dag lhan cig tu rgyas shing / bdag chen rgya gar ba'i drung du sa skya'i khyad chos dmar po bskor gsum gyi rjes gnang sogs kyang gsan zhing /

sgo rum du zhag bar bzhugs te rgya dpe rnams gzigs rtog zhib mo gnang / kha cig bod dpe dang gtugs te zhu chen kyang mdzad cing / theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud ces bya ba sngar ma 'gyur ba zhig bsgyur ba'i dgongs pas bsnams/ de nas gnam kha'ur phebs te/ bdag chen blo gros pa la mgon po lha brgyad kyi rjes gnang / mgon po zhal gyi rjes gnang bka' bsgo kha'u skyes lhas kyi brag sgo la dbu gtugs pa/ mgon po lha brgyad kyi yig cha mang po'i lung sogs gsan no/ /de nas zhwa lur phebs te/ ri phug tu/ sa skya nas bsnams pa'i rgyud bsgyur ba dang / mkhas grub pas mdzad pa'i dus 'khor gyi yig cha la mi 'thad pa snang ba rnams la dpyad pa sogs mdzad de re shig bzhugs/ de'i tshe phyogs su'ang / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i rgyud bsgyur gyi gda' zer ba dang / mkhas grub pa'i yig cha la dgag pa byed kyi yod pa gda' zer nas grags pa chen po byung bas kha cig gis 'ud yin bsam pa'ang byung / phal cher ni dad pa dang yi rang chen po byung zhing / la la na re khong lo chen rin bzang po'i sprul pa yin yang zer/ 'ga' zhig ni/ thon mi sam bho ṭa'i sprul pa yin nam zer nas/ snyan grags mtha' khyab tu byung ngo / /de nas slar dpal 'khor sde chen du phebs te/ sa skya bdag chen blo gros pas gsung ngag tshar gnyis gsungs pa'i rjes ma la/ rje nyid kyis kyang / kye rdor yab yum gyi bka'/ lam 'bras khrid la sogs pa gsan no/ /slar yang zhwa lur yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen slob dpon gsal ba grags pa las/ rgyal tshab byams pas/ 'od byed pa'i sa brnyes pa'i 'phags pa thogs med la gsungs nas/ thogs med kyi zin bris sam bsdu ba mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po'i sa dang lam gyi rnam bzhag mtha' dag gtan la 'bebs pa/ rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa chen po/ sa'i dngos gzhi/ sa mang po dang / sa mang po bzhi bcu bdun gyi ya gyal du gyur pa nyan thos kyi sa dang /

byang chub sems dpa'i sa/ gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba dang / gzhi bsdu ba dang / mdo sde bsdu ba dang / 'dul ba bsdu ba/ de nyid chos mngon pa'i sde snod yin pas/ mngon pa bsdu ba zur na med la/ rnam grangs bsdu ba/ rnam par bshad pa bsdu ba ste/ sa sde lngar grags pa'i lung yongs su rdzogs pa sogs gsan/ gzhan yang dpal 'khor sde chen du/ khang gsar ba'i slob dpon bla ma mkhar chen brag pa bsod nams blo gros pa la/ byams chos kyi gzhung chos thor bu dang / rnam 'grel sogs tshad ma bskor gyi thal phreng / spyi don gzhung chos sogs gsan no/ /yang zhwa lur/ rtse mo ba'i slob dpon rin po che brag dmar rab 'byams pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa la/ phar phyin/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i ṭīka lung gi snye ma las bshad pa gsan zhing / slob dpon rgyal mtshan rdo rje la/ gshed dmar lha lnga/ tshe dpag med lha dgu ma'i dbang / gzung grwa lnga'i dbang la sogs pa gsan no/ /de dag gis ni dgung lo bzhi bcu phan tsam du gtsang gi sa'i char bzhugs pa'i rnam thar sa bon tsam smos zin nas// ༈ /da ni nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams su phebs pa'i tshul cung zad ston te/ de yang lcags pho byi ba'i lo shar ba na/ ji ltar mkhan po bo dhi sa twa dang / jo bo rje a ti sha la sogs pa za hor gyi yul du 'khrungs kyang / phrin las bod du spel ba dang mtshungs par rje nyid kyang dbus su phrin las rgyas pa'i dge mtshan dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi mthu dang / 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos dge bcu'i khrims bcas te/ skye bo kun rnam par dag pa'i lam la bkod de/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo sde sogs bsgyur ba dang / 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyi lo paṇa khyad par can rnams spyan drangs te/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba'i rtags la bkod/ mdo sngags kyi chos phal cher bsgyur ba'i gtsug lag khang /

lha sa bsam yas sogs kyi bsngags pa gsan pas thugs phrogs shing / gzigs par bzhed pas/ rje nyid sku 'khor 'ga' dang bcas te chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ro/ /de nas 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa las lung bstan pa'i ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug lag khang du phebs te/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang pos rab gnas mdzad pa'i jo bo shākya mu ni dang / rang byon lnga ldan du grags pa/ jo bo bcu gcig zhal dang / ra mo che'i jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje la sogs pa'i spyan sngar/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin dpungs bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkod pas khyad par du 'phags pa dang bcas pa bshams nas thub pa'i mdzad pa la dmigs pa'i dad pa'i shugs drag pos gdugs mtshan du gsol ba 'debs pa dang / rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi tshigs su bcad pa dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs shes bya'i mdor bskor ba'i phan yon gsungs pa sogs thugs la bcags pas zhabs bskor la brtson par mdzad pa na/ sngon gyi mkhas grub dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos jo bo shāka rnam gnyis la gsol ba btab pa las bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po che 'grub pa'i rten 'brel rang babs su 'grig pa bzhin/ rje rin po che 'dis kyang bstan pa dang rang gzhan thams cad kyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grig pa dang / jo shāka gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mtshan ma gsal po'ang brnyes par gdon mi za'o/ /de ltar lha sa mjal ba'i thugs 'dun yongs su gang nas/ yer pa lha ri snying po dang / gung thang dang 'tshal la sogs pa gnas khyad par 'phags pa rnams kyang mjal te/ skabs su 'tshams pa'i mchod pa mdzad de rim gyis bsam yas su phebs te/ mkhan po rin po che'i dbu tho dang / g.yu'i thub pa'i sku sogs kyi rten rnams mjal zhing / de dag tu'ang sngar bzhin sems can gyi don 'grub pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam sogs mdzad cing /

dbu rtse rigs gsum gyi bkod pa dang / brda sbyor tshangs pa gling dang / sgra sgyur rgya gar gling la sogs pa'i gling phran so so dang bcas pa spyan lam du babs pa na/ sngon byon pa'i lo paṇa dang rgyal blon de rnams sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa sha stag tu 'dug dgongs pa'i thugs dad bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / khyad par du rang res kyang sngar ma 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mang po zhig bsgyur ba dang / sngar 'gyur zin pa rnams la'ang brda gsar rnying dang skabs stobs kyis 'gyur mi bde ba'i cha rnams bsal te/ 'gyur bcos byed pa sogs dang byed rgyu nas kyang bstan pa rin po che'i gsal byed du 'gyur ba zhig bya dgos dgongs pa'i thugs kyi nges pa dang dam bca' ba brtan po zhal gyis mches par nges so/ /de nas rim par phebs te lugs gnyis kyi mnga' bdag rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan spyan mnga' ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rje 'di'i snyan pa gsan pas bka' lung mdzad de/ dzong ji bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ mtshan gzhan dge mo rin po cher grags pa des/ tshong 'dus brag kha'i klu khang du gzhi len dos pa che bar mdzad cing / 'bel gtam mang po dang / sgra snyan sdeb sbyor la dri rtsad mang du mdzad pas/ rje nyid kyi snyan grags skye bo kun gyi rna lam du mdzes par byung ngo / /de nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jigs/ da ltar gyi sangs rgyas shākya thub pa/ ma 'ongs pa na shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas mi bskyod sman pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar rang nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa dpal phag mo gru pa/ mtshan dngos khams pa rdo rje rgyal po zhes grags pa'i gdan sa mthar rtsa zhes bya ba/ gdan sa chen po thel mjal ba la thegs te/ rten chen sgo mangs/ mchod rdzas rngabs su gal pa rnams gzigs nas/ bla ma gong ma'i phyag rjes dang / stod hor gyi rgyal po hu la'i stong phod sogs la thugs dad yi rangs 'khrungs te/

ya mtshan pa'i gnas su dgongs so/ /de nas gang mkhas par grags pa de dag ni/ rgyal po'i 'dun sar grags pa kho na yin pas/ der rje nyid kyis mkhas pa'i go 'phangs gsal bar bya/ smra ba ngan pa gzhan dag kyang tshar bcad par bya zhing / thabs de nyid kyis skye bo mang po yang dag pa'i lam la dkri bar bya'o dgongs pas/ gangs can rgyal po'i 'byung khungs/ sne gdong rtser phebs te/ lho brag gu ru chos dbang gi skye ba bcu gsum gyi tha ma bdag po kun dga' legs pa la/ saṃ skṛ ta'i gdangs su zhu yig bod skad kyis gsal ba dang bcas pa mdzad pas/ bdag po'ang mkhyen pa che bar bdog pas/ mkhas pa chen por shes te spyan drangs/ legs bshad kyi skyes su mang po phul bas mchog tu mnyes te/ nyid lo tsā ba chen por gda' gsung / 'on kyang sad pa'i phyir rgya dpe mang po bsham/ rtsis sogs la mkhas par rlom pa'i dge bshes kha cig kyang bsdus te/ dri ba mang po'ang byas/ khyad par rgya dpe rnams klog gsung bas/ thog mar rgya skad shar pa re klog de nas bod skad du tshar tshar ston pas mnyes te/ sngon gyi lo chen de tsho 'di 'dra gcig yod thang gsungs nas gus pa chen po mdzad de/ mtshan brjod kyi 'grel pa slob dpon dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa 'di sngar bod du ma 'gyur ba cis kyang bsgyur ba'i mchid gsol bas/ bstan pa la phan par dgongs te legs par bsgyur bas/ 'gyur 'jam zhing don bzang ba'i ched du gyur pa byung ste/ lo tsā ba chen por mtshan gsol zhing grags so/ de'i ring gong ma nyid la gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ mtshan brjod phan yon dang bcas pa'i lung / dbang mdor bstan gyi lung / nā ro zhabs kyi dbang mdor bstan 'grel pa/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyi ma dpal gyis mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi lta ba'i 'dod pa mdor bstan/ don dam brnyes pa pad+ma dkar pos mdzad pa/ nyi zla sgrub pa/ ye shes spyan sgrub/ dus zhabs snyan rgyud/

sha wa ra'i sbyor drug ngag dbang grags pa'i 'chi bslu/ dpe med mtsho'i sbyor drug rtsa 'grel/ paṇa chen nags rin lugs kyi sbyor drug dus 'khor dbang yongs rdzogs nags rin las brgyud pa/ zhal bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / de las brgyud pa la sogs pa gsan no/ /de nas 'phying (bang )dang stag rtser thegs te/ nang so tshe brtan pa yab sras kyi bsnyen bkur srid zhus mchod cing / rigs gnas kyi phan btags dang / khyad par 'tshams sbyor dang ming che dang sngags klog sogs bshad cing / nang so nyid kyis bskul te/ ka lā pa'i yig cha phran tshegs kyang brtsams/ rgyal mkhar rtse na yod pa'i bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur la/ stag rtse na med pa rnams mnan/ rgyal mkhar rtse na med pa kha cig stag rtse nas spyan drangs te byon/ de nas gong dkar rdo rje gdan du phebs/ gnas mjal ba dang / mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen dam pa rje btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal mjal te 'bel ba'i bka' mchid mang rab tu mdzad pas/ rje de'i zhal nas/ drung pa sngar nas snyan pa che bar 'dug de bas kyang mjal nas yid ches shing ya mtshan pa zhig byung gsungs nas thugs dges pa chen pos srid zhu chen po mdzad cing / rig gnas thams cad la dri btsad dogs dpyod/ phyag len bskor gyi sngags mang po la byings sgrub kyis gtan la phab pa'i zhu dag sogs mdzad cing / brtag gnyis skad dod ngo sprod 'bul ba dang / de'i rgya dpe phyag bris mdzad pa dang / ka lā pa'i gzhung las 'phros pa'i dogs dpyod 'bul ba sogs mdzad cing / grwa pa kha cig la sgra'i sa ris kyang bshad pa mdzad/ gzhan yang gsung rab mang po rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i zhu chen sogs mdzad do/ /de nas gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ ras chen pa'i gtum mo/ gza' yum gyi dbang / gur lha brgyad ma dang lha bcu gnyis ma gnyis kyi thun mong gi dbang bka'/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i dbang / nag po pa/ dril bu pa'i rdul tshon lha lnga dang lus dkyil gyi dbang /

gshin rje gshed ma/ zhal dgu pa/ zhal drug pa/ zhal gsum pa/ zhal gcig pa dang bzhir yod pa'i zhal dgu pa 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / zhal gcig pa gshed dmar bcu gsum ma'i dbang / mi g.yo ba sems dpa' sum brtsegs chu bsrungs dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang sogs gsan te/ slar yang gtsang la thegs/ dpal 'khor sde chen du zhu dag gi 'phro mdzad bzhin pa las/ lan gcig gzims lam na/ zhu dag pa'i sku chas do dam pa chos khrims bsod don pa zer ba cig yod pa/ khong gi sku 'gag gcig phul byung ba sku la bsnams pas/ gong pa grag ldan rnams gser chos las byas par 'dug pas/ 'di gang yin mi rung ngam gsungs pas/ me btong ba la 'kho ba yin/ 'o na mdun de'ang gser chos las byas pa yin zer ba rmis pas/ gzims sad ma thag zhus dag ni sngar bstan pa bsam nas bgyis pa yin na'ang / rmi lam 'dis/ da ni dkor gyi rang bzhin du zad do dgongs nas te/ de nas thabs mkhas kyi zhu dag gi khur 'bul ba mdzad na'ang / zhwa lu sogs su lo gcig lhag tsam bzhugs te/ sku nye bskor/ zhal slob gsar rnying sogs mang po la gsung chos dang / bslab bya sogs gang la gang 'dul gyi sgo nas 'gro don mdzad cing / 'gyur thor bu dang / sku zhang rin po che la gsung chos gsan pa dang / dus 'khor phyag chen sogs kha cig gis bskul ba po mdzad cing / zhwa lu mkhan chen chos grub pa la chos 'brel kyang gsan te/ mdor na nyin zhag re re zhing yang chos spyod bcu ma chag pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas sngar gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas phebs dgos pa'i bka' lung yod pa sogs kyis/ chu pho stag lo'i nang du dbus la phebs/ gong dkar du chos rje rin po che rdo rje gdan pa la chos kha cig gsan pa dang / 'bel ba'i mchid 'bul ba sogs mdzad/ de dus rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gi sprul pa/ zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa rje btsun sprul pa'i sku/ rin po che dpal chos kyi grags pa'i zhal snga nas phebs pa dang mjal te/

byin rlabs zhu ba mdzad cing / snyan grags chen po yod pas thugs mthong chen po mdzad do/ /de nas sdom pa la nyes ltung gi dri ma med cing / dpal phag mo gru pa la sangs rgyas dngos kyi snang ba dang ma bral ba nye gnas stag lung thang pa zhes skye bo thams cad kyi rna lam du grags pa'i grwa sa chen po stag lung du phebs te/ sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i bdag po mkhas grub stag lung rin po che ngag dbang grags pa'i zhabs drung mjal ba la thegs te/ de yang / rje stag lung pa de nyid sgra la mkhas par bdog pas/ rig gnas phal che ba la dri brtsad dang 'bel gtam mang po mdzad pas/ mkhas pa mkhas pa'i drung na mdzes pa de byung gda' bas/ rje de nyid kyis gsungs las/ kha sang snga thog sne gdong nas gong ma'i chab shog byung ba na/ 'dir lo tsā ba mkhas pa chen po zhig byon pas/ sngar ma 'gyur ba bsgyur ba dang / 'gyur bcos sogs mdzad kyi yod pas/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa sogs rgya dpe dgos gsung ba byung bas/ de rang mi bden snyam nas/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba de tsho las mkhas pa dag pa mi yong / dus phyis kyi lo tsā ba 'di tsho drag ka lā pa'i sa ris 'di tsam las shes pa mi snang zer ba'i zhu lan byas te/ khyed rang lo tsā ba chen por snang gsungs nas/ dges pa yang chen po byung / srid zhu bla lhag pa mdzad de/ sgra la bsten pa'i dogs pa mang po gda' ba rnams sel nus pa byung zhing / gur gyi rgyud la 'gyur bcos sogs mdzad/ chos rje kun spangs pa la ka lā pa bstan/ lāñcha na sogs dbyangs yig kha cig bslabs/ gzhan yang zhu chen dang / phag mo sgrub thabs zhig la bir+wa da mchos pa sogs mdzad pas shin tu dges de/ da res drung pa byon pa 'di la don chen po byung gsungs nas bya dga' mang du mdzad/ de dus nā ro chos drug dang / dad pa'i rba rlabs sogs kyi chos kyang gsan te/ de nas slar gtsang la thegs/ zhwa lu dpal 'khor sde chen sogs su chos 'chad nyan/

bsgyur zhus sogs bstan pa rin po che la ci phan gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' ba mdzad cing / de dus gong dkar rdo rje gdan nas rje'i bka' lung gis/ gur gar gyi sngags rnams/ ngor na rgya dpe bzhugs pa la gtugs pa'i zhu dag dgos byung bas ngor du thegs te/ kṛ ya sa muts+tsha la gtugs pa'i zhu chen dang / gzhan yang 'gyur bcos mang po mdzad cing / mkhas pa chen po chos rje go bo rab 'byams pa la/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i zhib bshad/ gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi dbang sogs chos kyang gsan no/ /de nas sngar sne gdong gong ma chen mo dang / stag lung pha rin po che dang / rje rdo rje gdan pa sogs kyis zhal lta nan tan yod pa sogs kyi 'brug lo la dbus su phebs te/ rdo rje gdan sogs su phebs dgongs mdzad na'ang / dbus gtsang gi dmag rnams kyi nag sogs su 'dzings pas lam bkag snang bas/ snye mo phyogs nas brgyud de stag lung du phebs/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal du byin rlabs mdzad nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon dkyil gyi lung / chos drug gi nyams khrid/ stag lung thang pas mdzad pa'i chos drug gi lung / de dag gi rgyab chos phag mo gru pa'i bka' 'bum pu ti bzhi'i lung tshang ma/ phyag rdor 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i dbang / 'jigs byed lha dgu'i dbang / de'i mngon rtogs/ las gshin gtor chog nyid kyis mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang / bum dbang bcu bzhi pa dang sku rags ma'i khrid/ 'bri khung pa'i bcu chos dang sum chos/ rgyud bla dang spyod 'jug yid bzang rtse pa'i gsung la zin bris nyid kyis mdzad pa/ zab gsal lta khrid/ rje bo dong pa'i gsung la nyid kyis zin bris mdzad pa/ spyod bsdus sgron me/ rim lnga/ rnam bzhag rim pa/ grol thig bdag byin rlabs kyi rim pa/ gur rtag pa gsum/ sbyong rgyud/ sdud pa bshes spring / do ha bskor gsum/ dmangs do ha'i rnam bshad/

rje yid bzang rtse pas mdzad pa/ byams chos lnga/ nā ro gsang spyod kyi khrid/ spyod yul bskor/ kun rig cho ga nyid kyis mdzad pa gzhan phan 'od zer sogs snga phyi mang du gsan no/ /de dus stag lung pa'i zhal ngo dang ban+dhe mang po la sgra bslabs/ de nas sne gdong du phebs/ spyan snga rin po che tshes gnyis pas srid zhu che thang du mdzad cing / 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jo bsgyur gsungs pas/ snga 'gyur mi bde bar yod pa la 'gyur bcos dang / sngar ma 'gyur ba'i phyed po bod la 'kho bar btus te bsgyur ba sogs mdzad cing / 'bel ba'i mchid sogs kyis mnyes par mdzad do/ /de ltar sne gdong du bzhugs tshe/ chos rgyal mi'i dbang po bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa sngon gyi rgyal blon de dag gi sprul pa lta bu yar rgyab dpon chen kun dga' bsod nams rin chen ngag gi rgyal po ba'i zhal snga nas kyis rje 'di'i snyan pa gsan te/ sne gdong du/ de na sngar gyi zhwa lu lo tsā ba de min pa'i/ zhwa lu lo tsā ba mkhas pa rang gcig yod 'dug pa spyir 'di phyogs su 'byon pa'i lung zhu zer ba'i zhu yig mdzad/ sngar gyi zhwa lu lo tsā ba min pa'i zer ba de/ zhwa lu pa rab 'byams pa bkras rin chen pa la zhwa lu lo tsā ba zer ba'i ming yod pas yin skad do/ /de nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ gzhis ka lhun grub gling du phebs/ mi'i dbang po de nyid mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing / thugs dad chen pos bstan 'dzin gus pas mchod pa yin pas/ srid zhu gya noms su bsgrubs shing / chos kyi dogs pa'ang mang shas dpyad de/ sngar chos rje dge bzang pa la ka lā pa'i sa ris dum gcig gsan gnang yang / khong gis bslabs tshul de sngon gyi bshad srol/ thog ma nas byings dang bcas pa'i tshigs chen po de kha yin snang bas thugs la ma long skad/ de nas rje nyid la gsan te/

man ngag gi bshad pa mdzad pas legs par mkhyen/ brgyad stong pa las rgya klog sogs kyang bslabs/ gzhan yang chos mang po la/ 'bel ba'i mchid kyis mkhas par mdzad do/ /de ltar re shig mi dbang dam pa de nyid kyis bsnyen cing bskur te bzhugs pa las/ skye bo mang po la blo dang mtshams pa'i chos kyang bstan te/ phan gdags pa dang / chos bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa dang / zhu chen sogs mdzad de/ bstan pa rin po che la phyag bris rgyun chags pa mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas spre'u'i lo lhun grub gling du/ gar dbang sprul pa'i sku rin po che zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi pa'i zhal snga dang phebs pa dang mjal te/ chos kyi gtsug lag mang po las brtsams pa'i gleng bslang mtha' yas pa mdzad pas/ mkhas pa chen por dgongs te/ bsngags bkur gya nom pa'ang mdzad cing / de nas slob dpon dbyig gnyen la rang las mkhas pa'i slob ma bzhi yod par grags pa'i mngon pa rang las mkhas pa'i slob dpon blo gros brtan pas mdzad pa/ mdzod 'grel gnam lugs thog zer gyi rgya dpe la stod byang pa'i bdag po rnam rgyal grags pa'i phyag tu byung ba chos rje yid bzang rtse pa'i phyag tu phul te/ bsgyur ba'i rtsis mdzad na'ang / sku nas byon cing spyan 'grib pa sogs kyis ma 'gyur ba de rje spyan snga rin po ches/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis bsgyur ba bskul te/ lhun grub gling du bsgyur ba'i 'go btsugs nas kong po bar zhabs 'bring mdzad/ legs par bsgyur zhing gtan la phab/ de yang spyir 'gyur byed pa la/ ka tsan sogs sgra mdo rnams kyi don phyin ci ma log par blo yul du longs pa gcig dgos/ de nas skad dod rnam grangs thug pa med pa zhig la byang ba cig dgos/ chos gang dang gang bsgyur ba de dang de'i chos skad don dpyis phyin pa shes pa zhig dgos/ snyan ngag mngon brjod sogs kyang byang chub pa zhig dgos/ de rnams tshang ba dang / dang por rgya dpe las tshig don shes par byas/

de nas don dang yang mi 'gal la bod la yang gang bder bsgyur na 'gyur bzang 'ong ba yin/ bdag nyid chen po 'di la de rnams ma lus pa mnga'/ de la sngon gyi lo tsā ba tsho/ paṇ+ḍi ta la dris chog pas cung zad sla/ ding sang paṇ+ḍi ta mi gda' bas/ lo tsā mkhas pa rang ma gtogs 'gyur mi thub/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis ni chos gang bsgyur kyang mkhas pa yin/ de yang / shin tu dka' ba rnams kyang / thugs bsam legs par btang nas mi mkhyen mi srid de/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mi gnyis pa kho nar rig par bya ste/ blo ldan rnams kyis so/ /de ltar 'gyur mdzad pa sogs kyi ring du spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs la gsung chos kyang 'di dag gsan te/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po/ 'dul ba me tog phreng brgyud/ sher phyin brgyad stong pa/ chos rje mkha' spyod dbang po'i bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs/ mdo sde mngon par 'byung ba/ sgam po pa'i thar rgyan/ thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bum gyi lung rnams gsan/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang / grub chen yu mo'i gsal sgron bzhi'i lung / gser sding pa gzhon nu 'od kyi gsang 'dus rim lnga'i khrid yig gdams phran dang bcas pa/ rim lnga'i khrid yig rje bus mdzad pa/ 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi lung dang / u rgyan bsnyen bsgrub nyams khrid du gsan nas/ rtsa ba zla seng ge 'grel pa dang bcas pa/ khrid yig lo rgyus/ gegs sel/ yig phran bskor/ grub chen pa'i rnam thar/ phreng bskor tshang ba dang bcas pa gsan/ mdo sde las brgya'i lung / 'bri khung zab chos/ tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa 'jam dbyangs bstod pa mjing yon du grags pa rnams kyi lung gsan/ gzhan yang de dus chos mang po gsan par gda' yang / gsan yig la ma btab pa snang ngo / /de dus sger pa kha cig la gsung chos 'chad pa dang / rje spyan snga nyid la gsan pa dang / chos bsgyur ba dang / 'dri ba dang / thugs dam zab mo la mnyam par 'jog pa sogs te/

paṇa chen shāka ri'i rnam thar las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /nyin zhag phrugs re bzhin/ mi pham pas dbus mtha' rnam 'byed du bshad pa'i chos spyod bcu ma chag par mdzad cing / kong po'i skye bo shing ltar gyong ba mang po'ang chos la btsud do/ /de dus kong po zhig gis phor ltang gcig phul byung ba de/ phyag phyir khams pa brtson 'grus bya ba gcig yod pa/ khos phor ltang khyer nas bros pa nye gnas pa rnam pa dang rgar pas zin/ khrims la gtugs pa'i nyes pa byung ba la/ rje nyid 'gro ba thams cad la bcos med kyi byams snying rje mnga' bas bka' gnang ste/ phor pa blos btang / dge ba'ang bsngos tshar gsungs nas phor ltang khong rang la gnang nas nyes med mdzad pa sogs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mang po mdzad de kun gyis dad pa dang / 'bul nod kyang mang rab tu byung / khyad par kong po'i bar de la/ spyan snga rin po che'i drung / ka lā pa'i sa ris dang / rgya yig mi 'dra ba mang po'i klog sogs tha snyad skor mang po phul/ gzhan yang gsung rab mang po'i ma gleng bslang 'bul ba sogs mdzad de/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum gyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad par mdzad do/ /de nas khyi lo sprul sku rin po che'i phyag phyi mdzad de phyir phebs/ de dus sngar kong po la thegs tshe/ sne gdong zhol du sde pa yar mar gyi phul ba'i na bza' kha cig yod pa gnas tshang la bcol yod pas/ phyir phebs dus khong gis btsongs tshar gnang bas/ phyag phyi rnam pas sne gdong du zhus pa'i nyes dmigs la thug na'ang / rje nyid kyis/ gtod lan kyang mi dgos na/ khrims lta ci smos pa'i zhus gnang kyang mdzad pa las/ nyes ma byung zhing / gong ma chen po'ang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod par gda' gsungs nas dad skad/ de nas bsam sder phebs/ g.yam bzang spyan snga chos kyi rje kon ding go shri'i rab byung 'di las slob mdzad/ slar yang yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po chen pos spyan drangs te/

phul du phyin pa'i bsnyen bkur gyis mchod nas re shig bzhugs shing / de yang / e waṃ thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid mkhyen brtse mtha' yas shing / bstan pa la gces spras che thang du mdzad pa yin pas/ rje 'di lta bu'i mkhyen rab kyis gsung rab spyi dang / khyad par tha snyad skor la yig cha brtsom pa bzhin byung na/ ci nas kyang bstan pa la phan pa 'dug dgongs pa dang / de yang dus phyis byon pa'i skad gnyis smra ba phal cher/ skad dod thor bu tsam las/ ka tsan gyi gzhung la gzigs tog tshud pa'i gsan sbyongs mdzad pa dkon te/ spang lo chen pos gsungs pa bzhin yin na/ cis kyang brtsom pa'i bskul ba po bgyid dgongs nas zhabs tog shin tu bzang po bshams te/ dben gnas dam pa e waṃ du spyan drangs/ re shig bzhugs par gsol te/ thog mar rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i ka tsan gyi gzhung la zhu chen mdzad/ de yang tsan+d+ra pa'i gzhung la zhu chen mdzad pa rnams ni shin tu ngo mtshar ba yod/ de 'dra bltas na/ mngon shes yod pa gcig ma gtogs gzhan gyi shes rgyur min no/ /de nas dang po ka lā pa'i 'grel pa gzhung don gsal ba zhes bya ba/ gzhung gi 'bru zhib tu gnyer zhing / dper brjod dang bcas te ston pas/ nyung zhing dril la rtogs sla ba zhig mdzad/ tsan+d+ra pa'ang 'grel pa sgra rig rgya mtsho'i gru gzings zhes bya ba gzhung don dpyis phyin par rgya skad bkod/ de nas bod skad bkod de 'bru bsnan pas shin tu legs pa yod/ de yang sngon gyi slob dpon kha cig gis byas pa'i bod 'grel rnams gzhung gi 'bru zhib tu gnyer ba med cing / dper brjod kyi tshig grogs rnams kyang byings sgrub byas pas/ mang ches te mgo rmongs par 'gyur ba las med/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa 'di lta bu ni bstan pa la phan pa bla na med par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de ltar rtsom pa mdzad cing / mi'i dbang po de nyid dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'grel zhu ba'i mchid nan tan du gsol na'ang /

rje nyid kyis rang gi bla ma'i phrin las su 'gyur ba dgongs nas/ bdag gis 'bul mi thub pas/ dus 'khor la shin tu mkhas pa chos rje rin po che bsod nams grags pa bya ba dpal 'khor sde chen na bzhugs pas/ de la gsan pa'i 'thad bkod zhus pas/ de kha bzhin gdan 'dren mdzad/ yon mchod lhan du gsan pa yin/ 'a pha/ dus ding sang gi bla ma slob dpon tsho ni/ rang re la phrin las byung na/ de kha a tshi ba rang du byed/ dam pa 'di ni bla ma'i phrin las 'phel thabs kho na lhur mdzad pa yin no/ /gzhan yang e wam̐ du chos bsgyur ba dang / zhu chen kyang mang po mdzad/ skye bo du ma la'ang blo dang mtshams pa'i chos bshad/ rgyal chen gling du dpon sa yum pa mkhyen rab kyi dbang mo de nyid dpon g.yog kha cig la/ ka lā pa'i sa ris dang / sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang brgyad stong pa'i rgya klog sogs thugs bzhed bstun pa bshad de/ sems can gyi don la ngal ba med pa'i rtsom pa mdzad cing / de'i tshe na/ mi'i dbang po rgyal srid chos kyi snying por skyong bas bstan pa stobs kyis 'dzin pa'i nyin mo'i dbang phyug mkhyen brtse phul du phyin pa mnga' ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang dbyer ma mchis pa dpon chen rin chen rnam rgyal dpang po'i sde phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha'i zhal snga nas 'di nyid/ sku nas phra mor yod na'ang / sku tshe sngon nas smon lam khyad par can mnga' bas/ rje nyid la bcos ma ma yin pa'i dad pa dang dgyes pa chen po yod pas/ phal cher rje'i drung du bzhugs te/ gus 'dud chen po mdzad cing / de nas bde mchog dril bu pa'i dbang gsan te/ dpon slob pha dang bu'i rnam thar la nges par gnas pa mdzad cing / bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pa gya nom pa bshams pa'i ngang mi g.yo ba yin no/ /de nas skabs shig tu stag lung du phebs te/ pha rin po che'i drung gsung chos gsan pa dang /

tha snyad kyi gleng bslangs pas/ de nyid kyi mkhyen pa'ang bltas par mdzad cing / de dus stag lung na/ sin+dhu'i yi ger bris pa'i rgya dpe yod snang ba/ kun gyis ma khrol bas/ rje nyid kyis klog bsgyur mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i dbus na mngon par mtho ba byung skad do/ /gzhan yang skye bo du ma'i mi shes pa gsal bar mdzad do/ /de nas yar rgyab tu phebs te skabs zhig na/ rig pa dang lung gis smra ba'i dbang po mkhas pa chen po shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta don yod rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ dge 'dun brgya phrag mang pos bskor te/ byings pas chos bar la gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ bying lhun grub brag khar rje 'di nyid spyan 'dren du btang byung bas/ bstan pa la dgongs te thegs/ sgra ka lā pa'i sa ris sdeb sbyor sogs bshad de mkhas par mdzad cing / slar mkhas pa de nyid la tshad ma rnam 'grel sogs tshad skor gyi gzhung don kyang legs par gsan no/ /gzhan yang de dus mkhas pa'i dbang po paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rin po che chos kyi dbang po dang / gter mdzod pa dang / rab byams pa bsod rgyam dang / rab 'byams pa grags 'od sogs 'chad nyan pa chen po rnams la'ang / ka lā pa'i sa ris sogs chos mang du bshad de/ de dag gi blo gros mkhas par mdzad cing / gzhan yang dbang lung man ngag sogs chos kyi rnam grangs mu med pa bstan te/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa lags shing / de nas yang slar phebs te/ e waṃ sogs su bzhugs bzhin pa las/ rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po chos rje dge bzang pa la/ mdzod rang 'grel gyi bshad pa dang / bzhi brgya pa/ snyan ngag dpag bsam 'khril shing gi lung kyang gsan no/ /de nas glang lo/ mi'i dbang po rnams kyis/ rje nyid phyogs 'dir yun du bzhugs pa ched sogs kyis/ rgya ston chen po lcags ri pa'i gdan sar mnga' gsol te/ dga' ldan byams pa gling gi bshes gnyen mang po la blo dang mtshams pa'i chos bstan te/

bstan pa la byi dor mkha' khyab tu mdzad cing / skyes chen dam pa rgya ston byang chub rnam rgyal de nyid la/ phag mo gzhung drug gi byin rlabs dang lung / dbu ma rtsa she/ chos dbyings bstod pa/ bshes phreng / dbu ma rin chen phreng ba/ bslab btus/ spyod 'jug rnams kyi lung / sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ rigs rkyang dang bsdus pa'i dbang / sngags 'dul chen mo/ rin chen sna rgyan/ mi 'jigs zhal lung / dus 'khor mdor bsdus dang po'i ṭī ka mngon rtogs mtha' dpyad/ sgrub le'i ṭī ka thams cad mkhyen pa byams gling pas mdzad pa'i lung rnams gsan no/ /de nas yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen grwa pa mngon shes kyis bzhengs pa'i grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang mchod khang gi khyad par 'phags pa/ bstan pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhi'i nang tshan/ grwa thang gi gdan sa chen por/ shing mo yos kyi lo'i 'grub sbyor bzang po dang ldan pa'i tshes la/ mi'i dbang po yab sras kyis dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gtsug rgyan du mnga' gsol te/ mdo sngags tha snyad la sogs pa rig pa'i gnas lnga'i sgo nas bshad nyan dbur rgyun chags su mdzad cing / nag pa zla ba la dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi sgrub mchod sogs dge rgyun mang po'ang btsugs/ mnga' ris nas chos rje bzhi sde pa sogs dang / sa skya/ ngam rings/ rta nag skyed tshal/ gsang phu/ rtse thang / 'bras ser/ nā len+da/ dwags kong / mdo khams sogs nas chos nyan dges bshes mang du 'dus pa la/ gang la ci 'dod kyi chos bshad/ khyad par ka tsan gyi gzhung chos sogs tha snyad la bshad nyan 'khor yug tu bshad/ lhun grub gling du mi'i dbang po la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang / lam 'bras sa skya bka' 'bum gyi lung sogs mdo sngags kyi chos mang du gsungs/ grwa thang nyid du'ang / sbyor drug lam 'bras/ gshed dmar/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang / bshad pa sogs lo ltar chags lta bu gsungs so/

/de nas khyad par du/ mdo sngags tha snyad dang bcas la 'gran zla med pa'i mkhyen spyan yangs pa/ bod yul sde snod 'dzin pa mtha' dag gi ral pa mdzes par byed pa'i cod paṇa/ rje btsun thu mi paṇ+ḍi ta gsum pa/ byams pa gling nas chos kyi rje shrī wā gi shwa ra puṇ+ya bi dza shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas la snga phyir ka tsan sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag sogs tha snyad skor cha lag dang bcas pa thams cad dang / gzhan yang dbang lung bshad pa man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' yas pa gsungs shing / mkhyen pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son pas/ rje 'di nyid kyi'ang slob ma'i mchog gcig pur bzhugs pa yin no/ /de nas spre'u'i lo/ sprul pa'i sku spyan mnga' rin po che gtsang la thegs pa'i zhabs 'bring mdzad de/ 'jam dpal gyi sgra mdo rtsa 'grel bying gi tshogs dang bcas pa/ sngon bod du ma 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos khyad par can bsgyur zhing / zhwa lur sngon gyi grwa slob/ sku nye phyag phyi ba sogs la chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas skyangs te/ rje spyan mnga' nyid la chos kyang gsan/ rtsom pa dang 'gyur zhus kyang mang du mdzad/ gser mdog can du ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros kyi zhal snga nas la 'jam dpal gyi bstod pa gang blo ma'i lung kyang gsan/ skye bo mang po la blo dang mtshams pa'i chos kyang mang shas gcig bshad de/ bya lo gtsang nas/ spyan snga rin po che'i zhabs 'bring mdzad de phyir phebs/ skabs shig tu/ stong ra phyogs su spyan drangs/ ri dor phebs/ stong ra ba chos rje shākya don grub dpal bzang po la/ sngar nā len+dar/ mtshams sbyor lnga pa'ang gsungs shing / 'di dus mngon rtogs ljon shing gi steng nas brtag gnyis kyi bshad pa/ skyes bu dam pa de nyid dang zhal ngo rnams la gsungs/ gzhan yang sku la chos drug bshed dmar gyi dbang / spros med kyi khrid sogs chos lung dbang bka' mtha' yas pa gsungs/ sgra'i rigs bka' bcad de/

skyes bu dam pa de nyid kyi mkhyen pa bltas par mdzad/ mkhas grub de nyid la slar rje nyid kyis kyang / lam 'bras pod dmar gyi lung / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi dbang sogs kyang gsan te/ re shig kyang bzhugs so/ /de nas slar grwa thang sogs su bshad nyan sku mtshams sogs kyis dus 'da' bar mdzad/ dpal 'byor brtan/ lhun grub gling sogs su'ang phebs te/ gsung chos sgo du ma nas ci 'dod du gsungs/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyang mang po sgrubs te/ mdor na/ btsun pa rnams sdom pa la bkod/ sngags pa rnams dam tshig la bkod/ khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod de/ skye bo mang po rnam par grol ba'i sa la 'god par mdzad cing / de yang sngon jo bo rje bod du byon pa ltar rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar mdzad pa yin no/ /tshal mig tu yang thog shig phebs/ rje btsun byams pa gling pa la sa sde'i lung / rje bsod nams bzang po'i zhabs kyis/ karma pa la dbang phul ba'i gos chen 'dings dkyil las dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gsung / gzhan nā len+da'i mkhan po chos rje bzhi sde pas spyan drangs/ gzhi ka sne'ur phebs/ khong pa la ka tsan cha lag dang bcas pa/ dus 'khor gyi dbang sogs dbang mang po bshad/ gzhan yang skye bo mang po la dbang lung sogs rgya cher gsungs/ mi'i dbang po hor don yod rdo rje bas bsnyen bskur gya nom du bsgrubs/ khong pa la 'bel gtam gyi sgo nas chos zab mo bstan te/ gzhan don la skyo ngal spangs te/ dus thams cad de kho na lhur mdzad pa yin/ de nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan rnam rol/ ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas drug pa seng ge da ltar rgyal ba'i dbang po karma par grags pa/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku thams cad mkhyen pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i zhal snga nas dang / sngar 'phrang po sogs su mjal te/ phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs gsan zhing / kong por yang mjal/ phag lo la/

lha sar mjal du phebs te/ chos mang po la 'bel ba'i gtam mdzad pas/ nyid lo tsā ba chen por 'dug gsungs nas bsnyen bskur gya nom pa mdzad cing / khyad par du gangs can gyi chos smra ba mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur mnga' gsol ba'i las kha chen po gnang ste/ gnang sbyin kyang shin tu bzang po mdzad nas/ lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid chos thams cad la mkhas pa yin pas tha snyad sogs rig pa'i gnas lnga 'chad pa'i slob dpon du mnga' gsol ba yin pas/ gangs can pa rnams kyis de ltar gyis shig pa'i (zhal gdams)shel dam bzang po'ang mdzad cing / re shig zhabs 'bring kyang mdzad de phyag chen gyi chos kyang du ma gsan/ chu bo aṇ+ḍa'i grong gi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po yid kyi shing rta zhes bya bas karma pa la gdan 'dren gyi zhu yig snyan ngag shin tu bzang po dang / phyag len bskor gyi sngags mang po la zhus dag dang / paṇ+ḍi ta sgra gcan 'dzin gzhon nu dang / kha che'i rgyal po chen po rnams kyis karma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig rnams bsgyur/ ar+ya de wa'i khab kyi tsher ma sogs kyang bsgyur te mkhas pa'i bya bas dus 'da' bar mdzad cing chos kyang mang du gsungs/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pas/ mdo sngags tha snyad dang bcas pa'i dka' gnas mang po dri ba dam po mdzad pa la/ dri lan dpyis phyin du phul bas/ rgyal dbang de nyid kyis mkhyen rab kyang bltas par mdzad/ skye bo kha cig la chos kyang bshad/ khyad par mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu dam pa rje btsun smyug la ba la/ ka tsan gyi lung sogs chos du ma'ang gsung / rgya gar gyi dge slong ār+ya baṃ pa la sogs kha cig la chos kyang gsungs te/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas slar yang grwa thang du phebs te/ 'brong dkar rdzong du mkhas pa'i dbang po chen po mtshungs med karma phrin las pa'i zhal snga nas dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma dang bcas te/ chos bar la phebs dus/ rje nyid spyan drangs/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud sogs chos du ma gsungs/ bka' bcu rab 'byams pa mang po la sgra ka lā pa yang bshad cing / e waṃ du'ang / rgya bla ma dpal ldan blo gros pa la/ dbang bka' lam 'bras sogs chos mang po gsungs/ rgya nag nas sne gdong pa'i las kha skyel mi gong ma rgyal po rtse de'i har shrī ba rnam pa la bsnyen rdzogs kyang bsgrubs te/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad do/ /de nas bya lo/ dgung dkag kyang yin pas/ rgya dril/ rten phebs sogs mchod cha/ gser dngul/ ja gos dar/ na bza' skor/ rta dre/ dkar dpyad/ go khrab/ khro zangs/ ra 'gag li 'gag ldi ri sogs phyag rdzas rnams thams cad sdom ste/ chos sde chen po zhwa lur 'gyed chen mdzad pa shar/ de dus zhwa lu mkhan chen dkon tshul ba la zhu yig mdzad pa na'ang / da res spongs dag brda mtshon sgrub pa 'di nyid/ brgyud pa'i bla ma bu ston yab sras/ rtsa ba'i bla ma sku zhang mkhyen rabs chos rje'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir du yin zhu ba'i phyag dam mdzad cing / sku zhang chos rje thugs la dran pas spyan chab kyang mang po mdzad/ de ltar 'gyed chen gnang ba la/ drung chen bkra shis dpal ldan pa dpon slob rdzangs pa/ ri phug gzim khang la zhig bsos byas pa'i dga' ston dang 'grig pas/ skabs su bab cing rgan rabs kyi dran pa tshun de las 'gyed bzang ba ma byung skad/ de nas bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid/ zhwa lu pa'i gdan sar spyan 'dren pa'i gros kyang bsham/ gdan sa su 'os la zan ril btong ba'i srol yod na'ang / rje nyid la byin mthun snang grub pas zan ril ma dgos shing / de nas mkhan chen pa/ chen slob mo dben dang bcas pa so so'i zhu yig nan tur bris pa 'bul nod dang bcas nas/ las chen brag dkar rab 'byams pa dpon slob snga phyir byon na'ang / mi'i dbang po sku mched kyis nan tur bzhugs par gsol bas/ nged kyis rje bu ston gyi gdan sa pher ba'i yon tan med gsung ba'i khengs skyung gi phyag dam kyang mdzad de/

thegs pa lhun grub/ slar zhwa lu nas/ drung chen gnyis/ las chen bdun dang / bcas pa rnams do gal shin tu chen pos byon zhing / rgyan gong du dpal ldan ma babs ste/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bod du 'gro zer ba sogs dad gus kyi rnam 'gyur du ma bstan zhing / de dus grwa thang pa rnams kyang / rje nyid la dad gus mtha' yas pas gzhan du thegs 'jug pa ma bzod nas/ zhwa lu pa dang thug phrad yong nyen sogs kyi thugs g.yeng du gyur na'ang / blo sbyong bsgom pa la khyad che gsungs nas skyon pa mi mdzad/ de nas chos kyi rgyal po sku mched pas/ nan tan du bzhugs pa'i gsol ba btab cing / chos sde chen po grwa thang gis gtso byas/ dbus kyi grwa slob byin gyis/ sku nas byon pa dang / dbus bzhugs spro zhing / thugs dam kyang 'phel tshul skyon nad zhus pa la/ dbus skyid cing / dge sbyor dmar kyang / de bas gzhan la tshig re tsam phan na'ang / de rang dga'/ gzhan la phan na/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal kyang dwang du len nus pa zhig dgos pas/ dge slong than thun dang / bde skyid don du mi gnyer/ na tshod mtho yang / re shig a tho yong / zhwa lu pa rnams de tsam rang du dad na/ khong rnams kyi bsam pa mi bzlog dge 'dun gyi bka' yang ma bcog pa yin gsung nas/ phebs par thag bcad/ slar mi'i dbang po sku mched kyis gtsos pa'i dbus kyi skye bo rnams kyi don du phebs pa'i zhal bzhes bzang po mdzad/ spyan snga rin po che nas kyang phrin las gzhan don legs pa yong ba'i lung bstan mdzad/ de nas zhwa lur mi 'degs gong / spyan snga rin po ches spyan 'dren byung bas/ mtshur phu gnas nang du mjal ba la phebs/ de dus kyang me tog gi char chen po 'bab pa kun gyis mthong ba byung zhing / lugs gnyis kyi gleng bslang bka' mchid mang du mdzad de/ gnang sbyin dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/ de'i zhar la/ zul phur phebs te/ chag lo tsā mkhas pa'i dbang po rin chen chos kyi rgyal po la/
