(zhang blon)zha 'on rdo rje bdud 'dul dang / tshe ring mched lnga'i rjes gnang kyang gnang / sgra'i gtsug lag gi 'bel gtam mdzad nas/ de nyid kyi mkhyen pa'ang bltas par mdzad cing / de nas chu shul du/ rin dpungs sde pa/ rig ldan chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang rnam rgyal bas spyan drangs/ dus kyi 'khor lo las brtsams pa'i dogs dpyod/ 'bel gtam/ lugs kha cig la brgal rtag gi sun 'byin dang bcas pa mdzad cing / rgya dpe mang po'ang bsgyur 'grol dang / khyad par rgya dpe'i steng nas bod skad thogs med du gsungs pas/ mi'i dbang po bshes gnyen du ma dang bcas pa rnams yi rang zhing / ha las te/ sngon gyi lo chen de dag 'di lta bu zhig yod thang zer nas dad skad/ chu shul du bzhugs dus kyang / me tog gi char byin gyis mthun snang grub pa babs/ de ltar bsnyen bkur zhabs tog bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsham/ skye bo shin tu mang po la chos kyang sna tshogs pa bshad/ khyad par mkhas grub dam pa chos rje u rgyan rdzong pa chos skyong rgyal mtshan pa sogs la/ dus 'khor rgyud 'grel gyi lung zhag drug la rdzogs pa gsungs/ de nas rje btsun smyug la ba'i zhal snga nas kyi smyug la rdzong du spyan drangs te/ lha'i longs spyod lta bus mchod de/ 'bel ba'i gtam mchid du ma dang / zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i gus 'dud chen po mdzad par gda'/ de nas rim par phebs te/ sngar smos pa bzhin/ zhwa lu pa'i gdan 'dren byung bas/ thegs par chas te/ chos rgyal sku mched gsum gyis gzhis ka byams pa gling / rgyal chen gling sogs su spyan drangs/ 'bul nod bzang zhing brlabs che ba mtha' yas pa mdzad/ dol sna mo la bar chos rgyal ma che bas zhabs 'bring mdzad de/ skyid shod du lcag ma bzhugs nas/ nang so rnam pa dang / rwa ba smad pa'i slob dpon la gzungs grwa lnga'i dbang sogs chos kha cig gsungs te/ rim par phebs/ gam pa phur smyug la bar gzhi lan thab 'dzin bzang po'ang rdzangs/

slar dbus kyi rgyal khams su phebs dgos pa dang / zhabs brten pa'i shis brjod kyi zhu phrin bzang po'ang sleb/ de nas rim par phebs/ de nas rin spungs na mi dbang chen po bzhugs pas/ zhag lnga'i bar bsnyen bkur mtha' yas pa mdzad cing / sman dpyad yan lag brgyad pa sogs kyis rgya dpe bsgyur 'grol ngo sprod dang / sngar lhun grub gling du bsgyur ba'i 'phro/ gnas brtan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i glang ru lung bstan gyi bstan bcos rdzogs par sgyur/ de nas ltag gru khar zhwa lu pa'i thab 'dzin bzang po sleb/ de nas rim par dga' ba gdong du phebs/ nang so lhun grub rtse pas gzhi len che thang du sgrubs te/ hor zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu dgu la zhwa lur phebs pa yin/ de yang chos sde chen po zhwa lu gser bkang du grags pa 'di nyid/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi slob ma lce btsun gyis btab/ 'go ba ye shes g.yung drung gis 'dul ba'i bshad pa btsugs/ jo bo rjes phyag phabs/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'bum phrag gsum pa dang / lo chen blo ldan shes rab kyis bshad grwa btsugs/ 'bri khyung gnyis kyi chos gzhis byas/ rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa gcig pu bskal bzang gi 'dren pa bdun par gsungs pa/ gangs can sus kyang 'gran mi nus pa/ kun mkhyen bu ston lo tsā ba chen po dpal rin chen grub kyi zhal snga nas zhes/ snyan pa'i grwa pas 'jig rten thams cad du khyab pa'i mkhas pa de lta bus/ mdo sngags tha snyad la sogs pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab thams cad/ 'chad pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / rtsom pa dang / khrid zab mo'i sgo nas/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar du mdzad pa nas/ deng sang gi bar du bshad rgyun ma chad pa'i grwa sa yin/ de lta bu'i gdan sa chen por phebs nyin kyang / nam mkha' la 'ja' 'od phra bo dang / dkar po'i rigs pas gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang / ljon shing gi rnam pas khyab cing /

dge 'dun brgya phrag shin tu mang po kyang / rol mo sna tshogs pa dang / gdugs rgyal mtshan sogs mchod rdzas mtha' yas thogs te spyan drangs/ gzhan yang glu gar sogs rtsed sna mi 'dra ba mang po'ang bshams/ skye bo'i tshogs bgrang bar mtha' yas pa 'dus pas/ bag ma la gong nas/ zhwa lu bar khrom gyis 'brel pa byung zhing / skya ser thams cad mgrin gcig tu dga' ba'i dad gus bde skyid mtha' khyab tu byung / de lta bu sngon zhwa lu'i mkhan po su la yang ma byung zhes zer te/ de ka med par yang 'dug de nas rten 'brel ni/ cha du ma nas 'grig tshes bcu dgu la phebs pa'i nyi shu la ngal gso mdzad/ nyi shu gcig la thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i dus kyi mchod pa khyad par can la khri thog tu mnga' gsol/ chos rgyal seng ge rtse pas khri bton 'bul nod dang bcas pa bzang po bsgrubs/ bla brang nas mkhan chen rin po che pa dang / 'jam dbyangs dkon tshul ba'i zhal snga nas kyang / gnas dgon 'bul ba 'gyed dang bcas pa gya nom pa mdzad/ chen slob sogs kyis kyang 'bul nod mtha' yas pa mdzad de/ shis pa brjod nas mnga' gsol/ de tshe'ang nam mkha' shin tu dwangs par/ 'ja' 'od kyi rnam pa sna tshogs pas khyab cing / ngo mtshar gyi cho 'phrul ches mtha' yas pa byung / skye bo kun kyang bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa slar yang khri thog tu byon zer nas mgrin gcig tu bstod do/ /de nas zhwa lu dang ri phug gi gtod rnams rtsis bzhes/ ri phug tu 'dus pa rgya mtsho la mang ja dang 'gyed shin tu bzang ba gcig gnang / mkhan chen rin po che pa la'ang 'bul ba bzang po mdzad cing / mkhan chen pa yang bzhugs te bsnyen rdzogs mang po sgrubs shing / de nas gzhis ka ba/ rtse shar nub/ pa snam pa/ tshong 'dus pa/ lcags stod sogs nas bsnyen bkur/ legs ja zhu mi mang ba'ang rim pas sleb/ khyad par gnam rtse sdings/ bde chen yangs pa can nas/ spyan mnga' chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs kyis/

rje nyid khri thog tu phebs pa'i legs ja/ brtan bzhugs shis brjod dang bcas pa phebs pa'i bka' yig na'ang 'di ltar/ rgyal ba'i gsung rabs mdo sngags mtha' dag dang / /tha snyad gtsug lag rab 'byams thugs chud nas/ /gangs can bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtsor gyur pa/ /kun mkhyen bu ston ring lugs rgyas gyur cig /ces shis pa brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ thams cad mkhyen pa de nyid kyi seng ge'i khri la mngon par 'khod nas/ bstan pa mtha' dag 'dzin pa'i rgyal thabs la dbang bskur ba/ skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po gang gi phyag tu zhes pa nas/ sku khams bde bar gdan sa'i 'dren pa dam par gtso bor gyur pa'i 'dus pa rgya mtshos/ bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba grub pa'i skabs su/ 'di nas kyang spro ba dang bcas pa'i ngag gis/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams la bden pa bskul ba'i gsol ba 'debs pa byas te/ deng nas bzung ste/ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phrin las yun ring du skyong ba'i bzhed pa yar ngo'i zla ba ltar gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur cig ces sogs kyi bka' yig ja gos dar gyi gnang sbyin bzang po dang bcas pa'ang byung / de ltar zhwa lu nyid du/ sa skya/ chu byang / dpal 'khor sde chen sogs nas chos nyan dge bshes mang ba 'dus pa dang / zhwa lu'i bla ma slob dpon grwa pa dang bcas pa la/ ka lā pa dang / snyan ngag sdeb sbyor dang bcas pa 'khor yug tu gsungs/ rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs kyang mang bar bsgrubs/ chos sde chen po'ang sgrigs rnam bzhag rnams dam pa mdzad/ sde pa rnam pas phul ba'i dge rgyun chags pa rnams blangs te/ spyi skyur la thebs la sbyar/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs su'ang / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' chems kyi yi ge rnams lan mang du klog pa mdzad de/ tshogs kyang kun spyod nyin re bzhin 'jam du song / spyi dgos gang du'ang khrims 'jags pa mdzad/ mkhan po'i bya ba yang / bu ston gyis mkhan po la gdams pa'i bka' chems nas 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin mdzad/

de nas zhwa lu'i dgun chos gsungs te/ thog mar blo mtho ba'i don du/ bu ston gyi phar phyin ṭī ka lung gi snye ma nas gsungs/ de nas kun gyi go sla ba/ chos 'byung chen mo gsungs/ skye bo'i tshogs shin tu mang po rnams la/ bsnyen gnas dang / skyabs 'gro dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / thugs rje chen po'i bsgom bzlas sogs/ nyin re bzhin chos mi 'dra ba re gsungs te/ gzhi byes kyi dge 'dun bgrangs las 'das pa lta bu byung / de ltar gsung chos su gsungs pa na/ tshig zur phyin pa dang / rna bar lhon pa'i gdangs snyan pos bsdu na sh+lo ka gcig tu chos thams cad 'dus par 'chad thub pa dang / rgyas par na gsung rab sh+lo ka gcig gis nyin 'khyongs pa 'chad nus shing / mdor na ci gsungs pa thams cad gsung rab kyi gnad dang / sems la phan pa 'ba' zhig 'byung ba lags/ de dus chos rwa rgya che ba rang du byung ba la/ chos khri'i nye logs su bsdad pa la gsung ha cang che ba dang / chos rwa'i mtha' ring por bsdad pa la gsung ha cang mi chung ba sogs ya mtshan gyi rtags mang du byung / me tog gi char pa shin tu che ba babs te/ kha cig gis lag pas 'dzin thub pa byung zer/ de nas phal che ba ri phug tu bzhugs/ sku zhang chos rje rin po che bsod nams mchog grub dpal bzang po bas bskul te/ rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang btsugs/ grwa slob shin tu mang po la gnang / sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'ang dge 'dun mang ba la gsungs/ de nas bsam grub rtser lo gsar la phebs/ gnyer chen sogs la chos kyang gsungs shing / de nas slar zhwa lur/ bco brgyad pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs pas bskul te/ dge 'dun mang po la rdo rje phreng ba/ thog shig la sbyor drug kyang bshad/ ri phug gi chos khri khar phebs te/ brgyad stong pa'i lung sogs nyi ma mang po'i bar dge 'dun brgya phrag du ma'i tshogs la gsungs shing / bu ston rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lung kyang gsungs/

de nyin nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shin du bkra ba/ bzo dbyibs ngo mtshar ba sna tshogs pa ri mo bris pa lta bu ches khyad par du 'phags pa byung zhing / bu ston sku gshegs pa'i rnam thar gyi skabs su spyan chab kyang mdzad/ sems can la phan pa'i chos gtam mang po'ang gsungs te/ shin tu yid mi bsrun pa rnams kyang chos la blo phyogs pa byung / de lta bu'i chos smra ba dang / chos nyan mang lugs bu ston bzhugs dus la 'gran bzod pa tsam byung / mdor na btsun pa rnams sdom pa la bkod/ sngags pa rnams dam tshig la bkod/ khyim pa rnams bsnyen gnas la bkod de/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa lags so/ /de nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa/ sa skya bdag chen gyis sngar nas mkhyen brtse lo tsā ba sogs la brgyud de snyan bcag kyang byung ba ltar zhwa lu na phebs yod tshul sogs kyi zhu yig kyang mdzad pa/ de nub bdag chen gyi gzim lam na'ang / paṇ+ḍi tas sngags mang po ston byung ba rnams/ bdag chen rang gis 'phral du mkhyen pa rmis pas/ de ring su byung kyang thong gsung bas/ de nyin rje 'di'i phyag dam gson pa yin skad/ de nas sgra gsan pa'i zhu yig sngags pa can mdzad byung ba dang / de ltar bstan pa la dgongs te zhal gyis bzhed/ rtse gdong du hor zla bzhi pa la thegs/ de dus bsam grub rtse nas mi'i dbang po dpon slob mang pos rgyang ring po nas bsu ba dang / zhabs spyi bor blangs pa'i gus 'dud chen po dang / bsnyen bkur bzang po mdzad/ de nas rtse gdong rin chen sgang du phebs te/ dge 'dun rnams kyis bsu ba gser bsgrang mdzad/ bdag chen rin po che 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po bas/ thog mar 'chi med rnga sgra'i dbang gsan/ de nas ka lā pa bshad de/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gnyis na rdzogs shing /

tsan+d+ra pa'ang zhag nyi shu rtsa brgyad phyin la rdzogs/ sdeb sbyor/ snyan ngag rgya klog yig ris mang po rnams zhar la bslabs/ sbyor drug dang / dus 'khor gyi dbang tshar gsum dang / lung rnams kyang gsungs te/ gzhan yang chos mang po bshad/ zla ba phyed dang gsum bzhugs te/ bla mas mkhas shing 'chad nus pa'i thog bcad/ slob mas thugs rab che zhing nyan nus pa'i thog chod pa byung / de dus rgya dpe kha cig 'dug pa la bsgyur 'grol kyang mdzad de/ de ltar bdag chen de lta bu la/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta gnyis pa bsgrubs shing / dad gus dang bsnyen bkur ni mtha' yas so/ /de nas sngar bka' bzhes kyang mdzad pa dang / yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po sku mched pas gdan 'dren kyang nan tan snga phyir byung zhing / zhwa lu pa rnams la'ang lugs gnyis ka'i sgo nas brtse bas bskyangs grub pas/ zhwa lu sogs su lo gcig bzhugs nas/ phag lo zla ba bcu pa la yar rgyab chos kyi rgyal po'i spyan 'dren byung ba la/ zhwa lu pa rnams sems 'theng bar 'dug na'ang / nyi ma dbus kyi rgyal khams chen por rim pas phebs te/ sna bo la nas mi dbang chen pos bsu ba mdzad/ dbus kyi grwa slob rnams bsam pa yongs su gang zhing / grwa thang gi dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos kyang rol mo dang gdugs rgyal mtshan mtha' yas pa thogs te spyan 'dren dang / 'bul nod bzang po mdzad cing / de nas gzhis ka byams pa gling / rgyal chen gling sogs su spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur 'bul nod dga' ston mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de nas byams pa gling du chos kyi rje rin po che dpon slob mang po la rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang gsung / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang gi nyin/ me tog gi char chen po babs te/ bla ma sman chu ba sogs kyis lag pas 'dzin thub pa byung zer/ de dus phyogs de na nad rims 'dug pa'ang / dbang tshugs pa nas chad cing / de ltar chos rje dbang tshar ba sogs kyi rmi lam kyang byung ste/

gzhan yang lung mang po'ang gsungs so/ /de nas grwa thang du/ nyang stod rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po sogs la dgun bsnyen sgrub sogs gsungs/ grwa thang gi bshes gnyen 'dus pa rgya mtsho la/ lam 'bras sogs khrid lung mang po gsungs shing / de nas dol gzhis khar thog shig bzhugs te/ sdeb sbyor gyi bstan bcos sogs sngar ma 'gyur ba kha cig bsgyur/ mdzod rang 'grel la rgya dpe dang sbyar ba'i gzigs thog dang / shān+ti pa'i sdeb sbyor la 'gyur zhus sogs mdzad do/ /de nas zhwa lu pa'i spyan 'dren chen slob byon kyang / mi dbang sku mched pas gsol ba btab pas/ 'phral du phebs pa ma mdzad/ byis blo'i spyod yul gyis mtha' dag pa ni ga la spobs/ 'on kyang blo dang mtshams par bstan pa cung zad gcig bris pa yin no/ /sngon gyi mdzad pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i mdzad pa ji ltar ston pa dang / yi dam gyi lha gzigs shing thugs dam khyad par can 'khrungs pa rnams ni/ gzhan la ye mi gsungs pas 'dri bar ma spobs/ de yang / sngon jo bo rje a ti sha la/ dge bshes phyag dar la sogs pa bod ston kha cig gis/ jo bo skye ba snga ma ji ltar yin bya ba dang / phyi ma ji ltar skye ba dang / 'tshang rgya na ji ltar rgya ba'i lo rgyus gcig yi ger 'bri ba zhu zhus pas/ jo bo'i zhal nas/ khyed kyis gtsug tor 'don ma myong ngam gsungs pas/ myong lags zhus pas/ 'o na gtsug tor nas gcad do mnan no phur bus btab bo bya ba de gdon bgegs ma lus par byas pa yin gsung / de bzhin du bka' dang bla ma'i man ngag bya ba la tshig gi phur pa btab pas byin rlabs chung du 'gro ba yin/ de bas na chos tshong 'dus kyi 'o ma bzhin du 'gro bas/ tshig zin par bya/ don go bar bya/ yi ger mi 'dri ba bya gsungs/ de bzhin du rje nyid kyang / lta ba dang yon tan kha tho la bskur ba rnams la gdams par dgongs pas/ thugs dam gyi 'char sgo 'di dang 'di byung ngo /

/zhes gzhan dag la zur tsam yang mi gsung bar thugs nyams su bzhes pa gtso bor mdzad pa 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i mdzad srol bla na med pa byang grol don du gnyer ba'i skye bo rnams kyi mig gi yar dpe rung ba yin no/ /de bas na yi ger 'bri ba mi snang ngo / /mdor na/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ni/ long sgrub byed pa'i skye bo la'ang lhag par brtse ba mdzad/ dus thams cad du bdag pas gzhan gces kyi mdzad pa las mi 'da'/ sngar blo sbyong gsan dus/ bla mas khyed rang gi dgra la'ang byams pa bsgom dgos gsungs te/ nga la dgra zer nas/ snying na ba su yang med gsung / slob ma la'ang / dam tshig la skyon byung bya ba nam yang mi srid/ gal te gzhan la phan na sku srog 'dor nus pa dang / sems can shin tu mi bsrun pa gcig yin kyang / rje 'di nyid mthong ba tsam gyis rgyud dul bar 'gyur ba dang / rnam pa thams cad du 'gro don kho na sku nyams su bzhes pa sogs/ byang chub kyi thugs rin po che rkyen gzhan gyis mi 'phrog pa mnga' zhing / sdom pa gsum gyi dbang du byas na'ang / so thar gyi sdom pa ni sngar smos pa ltar ltung ba phra mos kyang ma gos pa yin/ byang sems kyi bslab pa la btsun pa'i dbang du byas na'ang / bshad ma thag pa ltar/ theg pa chen po pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgor zhugs nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa shin tu brtan cing / byams pa dang / snying rjes thugs kyi rgyun brlan pas/ 'gro ba mtha' dag la dngos dang brgyud pas phan pa dang bde ba'i don du g.yo dang rgyu med par lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyun du sku nyams su bzhes pas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen por gyur pa yin/ de ltar byang sdom rnam par dag pas/ sngags sdom kyang rnam par dag pa yin cing / de la'ang / bla med dang / rnal 'byor rgyud bya rgyud de gsum du dbyer yod pa las/

so so'i bslab par bya ba nyes ltung mi mnga' ba ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i byang sdom gyis kyang 'grub pa lags so/ /gzhan yang / gzhi thams cad la gya gyu med pa'i bsam pa dang / nyes spyod las ldog cing bla med rdzogs byang sgrub pa'i gegs ma lus pa spong ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang / dam pa'i chos gsan pa la ngom chog mi mnga' zhing / ting nge 'dzin dang rdzu 'phrul gyi sangs rgyas mang po la chos gsan pa'i tshig don thugs su chud de/ mkhas rlom gzhan gyi rna ba'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa'i gsung rab shin tu mang po mkhyen pa dang / rang gi don dang dman pa yid la byed pas rnam par dben pa'i dgon pa 'ba' zhig tu mi bzhugs pa dang / 'dris pa dang 'khren pa mi mnga' bas sku skye ba snga ma rnams su rdzus te skyes pa'i tshul mang du bstan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod cing nyang gi sa la ma dges pa dang / bdag tu 'dzin pa sogs cung zad kyang mi mnga' zhing / rnam thar sgo gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin la dbang 'byor ba sogs sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar gyi yongs sbyongs rtags rnams mnga'/ gzhan dag gis bskal par yang 'grub mi srid pa'i bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don rlabs po che bsgrubs pa la/ bar du gcod pa'i mtshan ma tsam yang mi mnga' bar bde blag tu 'grub pa rnams ni lha'i bus bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / cung zad bsnyel ba na/ sman pa la ma ltos par thugs dam kho na'i stobs kyis snyun las grol bar mdzad pa sogs ni/ nang du dug bcom pa ste/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / 'chi ba med pa'i rig 'dzin mngon du mdzad pa sogs ni 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / gzhan snang la so so skye bo'i tshul 'dzin kyang / 'ja' lus brnyes pa sogs gsang ba'i rnam thar rnams ni phung po'i bdud bcom pa'i rtags dang / dus phyis nyin mo thun mtshams 'ga' zhig tu gzhan snang brnal ba ltar snang yang /

mtshan mo tha mal du nam yang mi brnal bar 'od gsal chen por bzhugs pa sogs ni ma rig pa'i gnyid sangs pa'i rtags dang / rnam grol don du gnyer ba rnams la nye bar 'kho ba'i don mi mkhyen pa gang yang mi mnga' ba ni shes bya la blo gros rgyas pa'i rtags dang / 'bad rtsol med par bstan pa dang sems can gyi phan bde shugs kyis 'grub pa ni/ khyab pa dang brtag pa'i bdag nyid can gyis phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i rtags la sogs pa mnga' ste/ mtha' dag pa ni 'phags pa'i spyod yul du rig par bya'o/ /mdor na/ dang por thos bsam mdzad lugs la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de rang mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / chos gsan pa dang / rtsom pa dang / bsgyur ba dang 'gyur chad bsabs pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka 'dra ba dang / 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas gzhan don mdzad pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba dang / bsgom sgrub dang bzlas pa mdzad pa la bltas na/ dus thams cad du de ka mdzad pa 'dra ba gcig yod pa yin/ rje 'di'i mdzad pa'i cha nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dbang du byas na'ang / nang par snga mo nas mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rim pa grol nas/ rlung la sogs pa la gnad du bsnun pa dang / de nas nyin mo'i cha chos 'chad pa dang / bsgyur ba dang / zhu chen dang / rtsom pa sogs mdzad/ de la chos nyan shes rab shin tu chung ba la'ang / sun pa mi mnga' bar tshar mang po skyor ba mdzad de/ khyed rnams kyis nyan nus na/ bdag gis 'chad nus pa byed gsungs nas/ nyin 'khyongs pa gsungs zhing / thun mtshams su mkhas pa dpe dang ma bral ba gsungs te/ phyag dpe rang gzigs/ skabs skabs su spang lo dang kun mkhyen chen po sogs kyi rnam thar kyang klog nub mo bla ma gong ma'i gsol 'debs dang / smon lam mang po mdzad cing / byang chub kyi sems rang bsgom pa gal che zhes yang yang gsung / de nas sil gtor grol nas/ thugs dam la bzhugs pa lags/ don du bdag cag gi rje bla ma dam pa chos thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzhin nor bu 'di nyid/

rtsod dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa rang yin/ deng sang gi mkhas grub gzu bor gnas pa rnams rje 'di'i gsung tshad mar mi byed pa gcig kyang med/ de yang rje btsun karma pa zhwa dmar nag sogs kyis ni rnam pa thams cad du bstod cing bsngags/ mkhas pa chen po chag lo tsā ba'i zhal nas kyang / rje btsun zhwa lu lo chen gyi mkhyen rabs 'di lta bu/ sku tshe dpag tu med pa nas sbyangs pa yin/ skye ba gcig la 'di tsam shes mi thub gsung ba dang / spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyi sprul pa bla ma smyug la ba la'ang / mkhas mchog thams cad mkhyen pa khyed med na/ /gangs ri'i khrod 'di mgrin bzang rwa ba bzhin/ /zhes gsungs zhing / rgya gar chu bo gaṅgā tshun la rje 'di las mkhas pa med gsung / khong la mngon shes kyang yod par byed pa yin/ rgya gar ji gi la/ ma hā bod+dhi'i bstod pa saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du sdeb sbyor dang ldan pa brtsams te/ rdo rje gdan gyi sgo la rlon par bskur bas/ saṃ skṛ ta bzang / bod na mkhas pa yod 'dug zer nas/ sangs rgyas pa rnams dga' ba dang yi rang ba byung / phyi pa rnams yid skrag pa byung ste/ rgya gar na'ang mkhas pa'i grags pa che ba yin/ gzhan yang rje 'di nyid/ sbyin bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs pa'i phyir/ nor rdzas la 'phral du dgyes dgyes ltar mdzad na'ang / zhen pa cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin no/ /de ltar mthong tshul mdo tsam brjod pa yin cing / slad nas kyang ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa ji snyed gcig ston bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lo brgya phrag mang po bzhugs par 'gyur bas/ ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa rnams 'dir rim gyis 'bri ba lags so/ /de lta bu'i rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid kyis bstan 'gro la dgongs te/ sngon med pa'i legs bshad kyis 'phags pa'i rtsom pa la'ang 'di dag mdzad de/ thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog bzang po'i sku bstod/ mkhyen rab rje'i sku bstod che ba zhwa lu pas bskul ba/

chung ba 'byang pa dge legs dpal bzang pas bskul ba/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho'i sku bstod bar khang mkhan chen pas bskul ba/ grwa pa mngon shes la bstod pa/ ma hā bod+dhi la legs sbyar du bstod pa/ mdo las bsdus nas bstod pa/ mdzad pa bcu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga la bstod pa/ dpal ldan rig mchog bu ram shing pa/ yang nyid kyis gsol 'debs gang gi 'od zer ma/ ja mchod/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la bstod pa dpal ldan thub dbang bcu pa/ tshig bcad brgyad pa nye dbang rdo rje dang / gzhan dbang po rdo rje'i sdeb sbyor gyis bcings pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'i rkang brgyad/ bstod pa/ dkyil 'khor phyag chen gyi zin bris/ bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong du bzhis dman pa'i bkod tshul bshad pa/ 'phags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyal po'i mdo'i 'grel pa/ grangs kyi gnas gzhan mdo sde las bsdus pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la bstod pa mgur la bka' drin mnyam med ma/ zhi ba lha'i rnam par thar pa/ spang lo tsā ba chen po'i rnam thar/ kun mkhyen chen po dol po ba'i rnam thar/ mkhyen rab rje'i rnam thar/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub pa'i dris lan/ bde mchog dril bu pa'i lus dkyil/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs dkyil mngon rtogs rgyas 'bring / dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs/ sa chog bdag 'jug rnal 'byor ma so drug gi mchod chog dus 'khor gyi rdo rje dril bu'i phyag tshad/ bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa/ sgra'i bstan chos ka lā pa'i 'grel pa/ tsan+d+ra pa'i 'grel pa/ ka lā pa'i 'tshams sbyor lnga bye brag tu bshad pa/ ming le yan gyi spyi bshad/ ka lā pa'i sa bcad/ me long gi bsdus don/ sdeb sbyor gyi bsdus don/ tsan+d+ra pa'i yi ge bsdu ba/ sum cu pa dang / rtags 'jug gi 'grel pa/

dag yig don gcig la ming du ma 'jug tshul gyi tshig bshad/ nyer bsgyur gyi bsdus don/ lce khyi phrug gi gnas brgyad bsdus pa/ ka lā pa'i uṇa sogs bsdus pa/ dbus pa blo gsal bas byas pa'i brda' gsar rnying la dpyad pa sogs sgra skor/ 'dul ba'i ma byin len gyi rin thang gi skabs su bcad pa/ sa skya bdag chen la bstod pa/ jo nang mkhan po chos rje chos skyong rgyal mtshan pa la bstod pa/ mkhas pa chen po kun dga' dpal 'byor la bstod pa/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po la bstod pa/ smyug la ba chen po la bstod pa/ rdo rje phreng ba'i brgyud pa dang / sbyor drug spros med/ dmar khrid sbyor drug brgyud pa'i bstod pa snang shas chos sku ma/ chos rje skyabs che la bstod pa/ lha mo rdo rje rab brtan ma'i bskang gso/ chos bdag ma chen mo ri phug ma'i bstod bskul/ de ltar thugs rtsom mdzad pa rnams kyang brjod byed kyi tshig snga phyi 'brel chags pa dang / brjod bya'i don phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ nyan pa po rnams kyis go sla zhing yid 'phrogs pas mkhas pa rnams kyi rna brgyan dang / bstan pa'i sgron me dam par gyur pa yin no/ /rgyas par bka' 'bum las shes par bya ste/ thugs rtsom la ha cang mi dges pas mang po ni mi bzhugs so/ /de nas 'jig rten thams cad kyi mig tu gyur pa'i rje btsun lo tsā ba chen po 'dis/ sngar ma 'gyur ba'i chos khyad par du 'phags pa 'di dag bsgyur te/ laṅkar gshegs pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'grel pa dbu ma la dga' bas mdzad pa/ theg pa chen po mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyud/ rgyud gsum mchod chog paṇ+ḍi ta dpal mdzes kyis mdzad pa/ sku gsum bstod pa bi ru pas mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs sha ba ris mdzad pa/

chos kyi dung zhes bya ba'i mdo/ gaṇ+ḍi'i bstod pa ār+ya de was mdzad pa/ tsan+d+ra pa'i don bsdus pa 'grel pa grub pa paṇ+ḍi ta nyi ma'i snying pos mdzad pa/ rdo rje gcod pa'i 'grel pa slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ 'chi med mdzod kyi 'grel pa 'dod 'jo'i mi'i sde chen man gyi bsgyur 'phro kha skangs nas bsgyur ba/ dus 'khor mngon rtogs mai tri pas mdzad pa/ bde mchog sgrub thabs tshigs bcad sum cu paṇ+ḍi ta sprin gyi gzhon pa'i lhas mdzad pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i lnga bsdus dang / gza' lnga'i 'grel chung / bhik+ṣu ā nan+da pradz+nya'i rgya dpe las byung ba'i dam tshig lnga bcu pa/ nag po chen po'i bstod pa brgya pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta dharma kīrtis mdzad pa mngon pa'i bstan bcos/ mngon pa mdzod kyi 'grel bshad stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug pa gnam lcags thog gzer du grags pa slob dpon blo brtan gyis mdzad pa/ bkra shis kyi mdo 'dus pa chen po'i mdo/ nyi ma'i mdo/ zla ba'i mdo/ bden pa bsdus pa'i le'u dang po/ gtor ma'i phreng ba blo bzang seng ges mdzad pa/ kye rdor 'grel pa/ pad+ma can gyi rnam bshad paṇ+ḍi ta he ru nan+tis mdzad pa/ rab gnas sbyin sreg gi cho ga ka dza da pas mdzad pa/ dbyig gi phreng ba/ ma hā bo d+dhi'i bstod pa mchog sred kyis mdzad pa/ zla ba grags pa'i smon lam/ kye rdor/ mngon rtogs dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgra mdo'i byings kyi tshogs dang / gzhung skabs brgyad sh+lo ka brgya phrag bdun yod pa/ 'jam dpal gyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta sa dhu kīrtis mdzad pa/ 'di'i rgyan 'grel pa phyed lhag pa/ pā ṇi ni'i sgra mdo nyung ngu skyes bu mchog gis mdzad pa/ mngon brjod kyi bstan bcos chen po mu tig gi phreng ba'am/ sna tshogs gsal ba zhes bya ba paṇ+ḍi ta dpal 'dzin sdes bkod pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug lung brtan/

glang ru lung bstan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ ār+ya de ba'i khab kyi tsher ma klu grub kyis mdzad pa/ bram ze'i 'dod pa 'gog byed nag mo'i 'bangs kyi bkra shis/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bstod pa dza ya se nas mdzad pa/ seng ge'i sgra'i bstod pa gnyis skyes bsrung bas mdzad pa/ tshigs bcad gcig pa'i don 'grel phyogs glang gis mdzad pa/ mdzod kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ klu grub kyis sangs rgyas la bstod pa rgyun chags/ sdeb sbyor gyi gzhung / paṇ+ḍi ta yid kyi shing rtas thams cad mkhyen pa karma pa la phul ba'i zhu yig paṇ+ḍi ta shi ro ma ṇis ngor chen kun dga' bzang po la bstod pa/ bhik+ṣu di baṃ ka ras gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa chen po la bstod pa la sogs pa rnams so/ /de ltar rmang 'gyur mdzad pa rnams ni 'gyur legs pa'i dpe thub pa yod/ de 'dra la bltas na/ blo ldan rnams dad pa mi 'gro ba'i dbang med pa lags/ de nas sngar 'gyur ba la'ang 'gyur mi bde ba dang / 'gyur log pa dang / 'gyur chad pa sogs dang / phyis yi ge pas bris nor du byas pa sogs mi bcos su mi rung ba rnams rgya dpe la gtugs pa'i zhu chen mdzad pa ni/ bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur phal che ba la yod kyang yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pas 'dir kha cig tsam 'bri na/ mi g.yo ba brtul phod pa'i rgyud/ mtshan brjod 'grel pa nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa/ rnal 'byor ma kun spyod kyi rgyud/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa/ dbang mdor bstan/ gsang 'dus rgyud phyi ma/ rdo rje gur gyi rgyud/ 'chi med mdzod rtsa ba/ 'dod 'jo'i bstod pa/ dpa' bo dngos grub kyi rgyud/ nor rgyun mas mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa brgyad pa/ gaṇ+ḍi'i bstod pa rnams rta dbyangs kyis mdzad pa/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ ye shes snying rje kun las btus pa/ slob ma la spring pa/ bshes spring / ched du brjod pa'i tshom/

ka lā pa'i mdo/ byings kyi tshogs/ tsan+d+ra pa'i mdo/ byings mdo/ uṇa sogs/ sher phyin yi ge nyung ngu / gza' yum gzungs/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i gzungs/ mdo za ma tog bkod pa/ sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud/ gdugs dkar phyir bzlog ma chen mo/ kye rdor/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ rnam rgyal/ ltung bshags/ bzang spyod/ bde mchog lo hi pa'i mngon rtogs/ dril bu pas mdzad pa'i sdom pa lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs/ bla ma lnga bcu pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs stong nyid ting nge 'dzin rdo rjes mdzad pa/ de'i 'grel pa brtson 'grus dpal bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs in+d+ra bo dhis mdzad pa/ klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sems rnam par dag pa'i rab byed/ des mdzad pa chos dbyings bstod pa/ tshe mdo/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya/ kye rdor pad+ma can mtsho skyes kyis mdzad pa/ phyag bzhi pa'i bstod pa brgyad pa/ bsngags 'os bsngags bstod le'u dang po/ byams chos lnga/ sgrol ma nyer gcig sher snying / dpag bsam 'khri shing / me long / sdeb sbyor rin chen 'byung gnas rtsa 'grel/ klu grub kyi yum rgyas pa/ dum bu bzhi'i dngos don bstod pa/ spyod 'jug bsngo le/ mngon pa mdzod/ lum ba'i so thar mdo/ mdo bsdud pa/ kun rig gi mtshan brgya/ mngon pa kun las btus/ rmi lam gyi phreng ba lung bstan pa'i cho ga su kaṃ gi bhik+ṣu di bāṃ ka ra dang / glo bo lo tsā bas bsgyur ba rje nyid kyi gtan la phab pa/ tsan+d+ra pa'i gting mtha' rgyas pa/ yi ge'i mdo'i 'grel pa sngar ma 'gyur ba/ kho bo'i 'gyur byang yod pa'ang / rje nyid kyi gsung las byung ba'o/ /'o na sngon gyi lo tsā ba de nyid bdag gis bsgyur pa 'chos mi dgos snyam na/ ma yin te/ dpang lo chen pos/ ka lcog rnam gnyis rin chen bzang po dang / /blo ldan shes rab shongs ston rdor rgyal sogs/

/mkhas pas bsgyur la'ang 'gyur nyes phra mo dag /'byung na gzhan dag rnams la smos ci 'tshal/ /zhes gsungs/ der ma zad phyis bod kyi yi ge pa blun po dang / 'chad pa po rnams kyi rang bzos bcos ma mang bas/ zhu chen cis kyang gces pa yin/ de ltar zhu chen mdzad pa dang / 'gyur chad bsab pa rnams shin tu ngo mtshar ba bla na med pa yod pas/ 'dir kha cig rgya skad dang bcas te bris na/ blo ldan rnams dad gus bskyed pa yod na'ang / shes par 'dod pas ni bstan bcos de dag las rtogs shing / 'dir bkod kyang / bstan bcos la blo ma byang ba rnams kyis go mi nus pas ma bris so/ /de lta bu'i bstan pa la phyag bris sngon med pa mdzad pa'i rje bla ma/ mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i lo tsā ba chen po 'di nyid kyi gsung las 'khrungs pa'i mkhas grub mtha' yas pa las kyang ches mtha' yas bzhugs pas/ ma lus par ni 'bri bar mi ldang zhing / grags che ba kha cig brjod na/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sprul pa sa skya bdag chen 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas dang / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa dpal bzang po/ thu mi paṇ+ḍi ta gsum pa skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po rje btsun byams pa gling pa'i zhal snga nas/ glang thang spyan snga/ sgam po spyan snga/ g.yam bzang spyan snga/ tshogs chen po'i mkhan po paṇa chen dwags po rab 'byams pa dang / mkhyen rab dbang phyug pa/ rten khebs nang so chen mo dge 'dun sgang gi mkhan po chos grub seng ge nor bu ba bye rdzing gi mkhan po zla chos pa/ zla bkras pa/ rab 'byor ba/ kong 'phags mkhan po dpal 'byor ba/ dge legs dpal ba/ da lta'i khri thog pa/ gtsang 'phags mkhan po bsod nams dpal bzang dang / rin grags pa/ lha khang ke ru'i mkhan po rin po che dang gdan sa pa chos rgyam/ chos rje karma phrin las pa/ chos rje smyug la ba/ chos rje stong rwa ba/ stag lung chos rje rnam rgyal grags pa dpal bzang po/

bsam yas dbu tshal ba'i lha sras btsun pa/ nā len+da'i mkhan po bzhi sde pa rnam rgyal/ mngon dga'i mkhan po 'chi med grub pa'i sku skye/ ru dgon gsar gyi mkhan po sku zhang chos rje rin po che bsod grub dpal bzang po/ jo nang gi mkhan po chos skyong rgyal mtshan/ snar thang mkhan po bsod nams dbang phyug gser mdog can gyi mkhan po paṇa chen gyi dbon po/ rgya nag rgyal po'i bla ma dpal ldan blo gros/ 'jang rgyal po'i bla ma rong chung sangs rgyas dpal bzang po/ yang 'jang gi bla ma bsod nams bzang po/ slob dpon kun tu bzang po sogs/ chu byang pa'i slob dpon/ rab 'byams pa chos shes sogs rdzong dkar ba'i slob dpon/ slob dpon chos nyi ba dang / legs ldan sogs chos lung gi slob dpon/ nyang stod rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po dang / rab 'byams pa bzod pa sogs dpal 'khor sde chen gyi slob dpon/ rje gung chen/ slob dpon shes rab pa sogs rtse chen gyi slob dpon/ slob dpon zla rgyam sogs byams chen gyi slob dpon/ mnga' ris rdzong dkar ba'i bla ma rab 'byams pa dpal bkras/ slob dpon don grub legs bzang dang / slob dpon 'od srung sogs gsang phu'i slob dpon/ slob dpon sde bdun pa dang / nyi ma bkra shis sogs karma kaṃ tshang gi slob dpon/ slob dpon rig pa'i glog phreng dang / kun dga' rgyal po sogs gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi slob dpon/ chos grwa rtse thang gi ha lo sgang pa sogs rtse thang gi chen slob/ chos 'khor sgang gi gdan sa pa rab 'byams pa tshe dbang pa sogs/ dga' ldan byams pa gling gi chen slob/ thel gyi chu sgo ba paṇa chen 'bum rab 'byams pa rin chen chos dbang sogs gdan sa thel gyi bla ma slob dpon/ srad brag dmar gyi mkhan po/ yang dgon rgyal ba rdzong gi gdan sa pa/ bco brgyad pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa sogs nā len+da'i slob dpon dang dus mchod pa/ stag lung gdan sa pa'i slob dpon dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs stag lung slob dpon/

lho gnas mchog dpal gyi tsa ri'i gcig char rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs bsgrub rgyud pa rnams dang / rgya gar suk+kaṃ gi paṇ+ḍi ta dharma di bāṃ ka ra ār+ya baṃ pa/ sa dharma baṃ pa/ shī la pa tha ra/ dharma kīrti/ glo bo lo tsā ba dpal ldan grags pa/ mkhyen brtse lo tsā ba rab legs/ se ra lo tsā ba kun dga' bzang po/ sne gdong dbang gi las ka skyel mi he shrī lhun grub bkra shis/ dbang ldan chos 'khor gyi gdan sa pa dang / thar gling gdan sa pa bka' bcu smra ba/ pho brang sne gdong gi dkon gnyer ba'i dpon nang so chos 'byung chos mdzad/ gzhi ka lhun grub gling gi dkon gnyer dpon ngag dbang kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ skyi shongs chos mdzad pa sogs mkhas pa dang / grub pa dang / chos sde chen po'i mkhas slob tu gyur pa dang / rigs rus kyi 'phags pa sogs mtha' yas te/ mdor na/ bod dang bod chen po dang / rgya nag dang rgya nag chen po dang / 'phags pa'i yul gyi bar/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i slob ma dang yang slob dang nying slob kyis phyogs thams cad du khyab pa lags so/ /chos sde chen po zhwa lu dang / grwa thang na dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa rnams ni/ chos sde de dag gi bla ma mdzad pa yin pas zur du smos mi dgos so/ /da dung kyang mkhas grub kyi slob ma bgrang bar yas pa zhig 'byon par 'gyur ba rnams skabs 'dir mnan par bya'o/ /de ltar bla ma dam pa thams cad mkhyen pa lo chen zhabs kyi rnam par thar pa cung zad tsam 'di nyid/ mkhas pa'i dbang po mang du thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa rin chen chos kyi dbang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rnam thar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba yod pa las cung zad btus shing / phyis kyis mdzad pa'i phreng ba kha cig kyang bsnan te/ snyan ngag gi rgyan 'khyog po la sogs pa spangs nas/ go bde ba'i ngag gis bkod pa yin/

slad nas kyang bdag nyid chen po'i zhal slob mkhas pa chen po dag gi 'di lta bu la sa bon du mdzad de/ snyan ngag gi rgyan sna tshogs pa bkod pa sargas bcings pa'i rtogs brjod chen po mdzad par zhu/ 'dir yang ji lta bar brjod ma thub pa dag bzod par gsol zhing / ji ltar brjod pa de dag gsungs la gtugs pa lags pas sgro btags pa ni cung zad kyang med pa yin no/ /'di ni rje nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bka' dang / rjes su gnang ba'i bka' yin pas/ lung gi bka' drin kyang rje nyid la zhu bar rigs pa lags so/ /de ltar bung ba'i bgrod pa yis/ /nam mkha'i khyon rnams ji ltar 'jal/ /'on kyang rang gi skal ba dang / /'tshams par bstan pa kha cig brjod/ /'dir 'bad dge bas dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse kun gyi dngos/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs/ /'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir rtag bzhugs shog /bdag kyang skye zhing skye bar yongs 'dzin dam pas rjes bzung nas/ /bslab gsum gyis spras ba'i thob dpal 'byor khengs pa med pa dang / /rigs gzugs ldan zhing bstan la mtshungs pa med pa'i snyan ngag mkhan/ /skye bo'i yid 'phrog snying rje che ldan bstan pa'i sgron mer shog /sgrib pas bslad pa'i skye bo dag /phyogs su lhung phyir dam pa la'ang / /dad pa'i bsod nams ma bsgrubs pa/ /de dag spyod yul 'di ma yin/ /bskal par legs bya zong gis thob pa yi/ /dad pa'i nor bu mnga' ba de dag gis/ /snying la dpyid kyi dga' ston bsam yas pa/ /ci yang bskrun pa'i bsod nams 'dis byed do/ /zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun 'di nyid kyi zhabs 'bring yun ring du bsten pa skyogs kyi btsun pa rgyal kham pa dpal rin chen bkra shis blo gros ngo mtshar bye ba'i gter zhes bya bas/ drung gi mchod g.yog pa bla ma bka' gdams pa chen po dharma tsakra bas/ gsung ngar mas yang yang bskul ba dang / bdag nyid kyi yid la'ang ring du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/
